title: Attractive, easy to program, not sure of the accuracy
text: Not sure why all the negative reviews out here. Yes, the packaging wasn't necessarily easy to open, but there are a lot of products out here on the market today like this. I had no trouble inserting the batteries in the remote or in the temperature display, it was a little confusing to insert in the rain catcher, but I ended up figuring that out, too (and trust me, I am usually awful at these things). As others stated, the display is clear and large and it was easy to program. I rated this as 4 stars as I am not too confident that the temperatures being displayed are accurate. I mean, I typically keep my thermostat at 74 degrees in the house (and the display on my A/C shows that). However, the La Crosse is picking up the inside temp as 76. Now, it could be because I have it near a window, but I need to have it near a window to pick up the outside controls. The outside temperature, positioned as instructed in the shade, seemed to indicate a lower temp than what it felt and the weather channel said it was (TV said 86, thermometer showed 82, but it felt like 86). So, anyway, I am not sure about the accuracy of the temps, but overall it is a conversation piece and I find the rain catcher seemed to do a good job (we had a big thunderstorm here last night and it picked up .25 of an inch).

title: Weber quality in a smaller grill
text: For the last 15 or so years, I have depended on Weber for all of my outdoor grilling needs. Having had full size (Weber Genesis) most recently, I wanted to see what the difference was using a table top version (that I could use when not wanting to fire up the full size grill and also to take on camping trips). I was pleasantly surprised with the Weber 2200. First, it is larger (and heavier) than I expected. Grill/cooking space wise, I couldn't ask for more space for two people. It is sturdy, lights like a full size grill and I love the LED light that lights the surface when the grill top is opened. I honestly have put the grill on my patio full time now and have used it almost exclusively for the past few weeks. I find cleanup easier than the full size and the fat drains off cleanly and efficiently. I may never go back again to the Genesis (unless of course I have a party with many people there). But, if that's the case, I may use the full size for hot dogs and burgers and use the 2200 for kabobs (fire them both up). I love it!!!

title: Good for really small spaces
text: Let me begin by saying that I have a room in my home that works as a combination bedroom at night, office during the day. As such, I spend most of my time in the room and hate to spend a lot of money heating the whole house. So, I usually will keep the house around the low 60 degree mark and then use a space heater in my room to keep the temperature a bit warmer in the space I am in most of the time. Usually, I have a full size Lasko model that keeps my 11x18 room relatively toasty. I received this Bionaire model through Vine earlier this month and, on one of the coldest days of the fall this year, decided to try it out. To begin with, it is compact.. maybe 8-9 inches high and maybe 9 inches wide. It has a rotating (optional) fan to help circulate the air (my Lasko actual rotates the unit from side to side to do the same). It is attractive and looks like a small table fan when in use. Downside is the size, it is not really big enough to handle this room (unless I kept the door shut and the unit running constantly and eventually the corners would show an increase in room temp). It's great to keep right next to me on floor while I am at my desk to warm my immediate space. It's also relatively noisy (the Lasko is much quieter).

title: Just perfect for my yard - almost
text: Got this through the Vine program. Positives: Extremely attractive. I live in a townhouse with a relative small backyard. I don't have trees in my yard, so I use a decorative pole which I attached the Birdscapes feeder to. It looks absolutely gorgeous out there and the birds are out there daily. Having water and seed together is a new and unique concept to me as I have always just used a seeder (and let the birds get their water elsewhere, lol). I love watching the birds my window flock back and forth to both. It was easy to set up and has provided hours of enjoyment for my family, and my cat. I definitely see more birds in my yard having the combination of water and seed than I did with just my regular birdfeeders. Here are the negatives: There is nothing in this set up that will deter small wildlife (i.e. squirrels) from hanging and making a huge mess (with both the seed and the water. I try to offset this by keeping a small bowl on the ground filled with peanuts and other items that are attractive for the squirrels. I am thinking if this was hanging from a tree, and higher up off the ground, maybe it wouldn't be quite as accessible. However, there are other (and I have used them often) feeders that discourage the critters and make it difficult for them to access the seed. This is definitely not one of them. Overall, I recommend this set up simply because of its beauty and for the way I am seeing far more birds than ever in my yard.

title: Not bad for the money, but not great
text:
Let me start by saying some positives about these planters. First, I was surprised at how big they were. Guess I couldn't tell from the pictures their size. The larger one could easily plant a small tree in (i.e. if you were in the south, you could plant a small orange tree). Second, they were heavier and sturdier than I anticipated (no fear in leaving it on the patio and having it blow over). What I didn't care for it was the color first (a super drab grey), the feel of the pot (some kind of a metallic) and most importantly the fact that there is no drainage in the bottom (not good for root rot). I planted a rose bush in the large one to put out on my outside patio. Given that I don't have any kind of drill to make a hole in it, I am just hoping that the watering I am doing will not collect on the inside of the planter to harm the plant (I have several inches of potting soil beneath the roots and the bottom of the planter). I am sure, if I were handier or if I was more of a horticulturist I could have figured out how to solve this dilemma.
Follow up 06-04-2011: Well, the inevitable happened. Without drainage holes in this, my rose bush died last year. There was so much collected water in the bottom (from rain) that although you couldn't see it from the top, the roots goet all rotted. The planter sat in my garage over the winter. Last weekend, a friend drilled five holes in the bottom of the planter for me and I replanted (this time with a large tomato plant). I will let everyone know how it goes. If I had the opportunity, I would have changed the rating of this to 1 or 2 stars for the aggravation and death of my rose bush. Never saw a planter that was set up like this before, really bad design. These are not cheap either, but honestly they are not worth the money at all.

title: BAD MASTERBUILT / GOOD AMAZON
text: First off I need to say that I have never been more proud of amazon than I am today. Amazon was amazing in taking care of this issue. Now to get started, this will take a few minutes, but please read this. I purchased the Masterbuilt 30 inch smoker in green first. There was a huge gap in between the door and the smoker. You could actually see the grates looking from the outside in. Amazon was great and returned it and gave me the red 30 inch Masterbuilt smoker for just $10.00 more. The red smoker arrived and had a gap in the exact place. Thinking it was a factory defect, I contacted Masterbuilt and requested a pick up and a new working, gap free smoker. Boy was I surprised when I got their response. Masterbuilt stated it was the door that was the problem. Explaining to a supervisor that it was not the door was painful. I had to send them about 25 pictures of the damage and she told me it was the door and that all they would do for me was send me a new door. I explained that they already sent me a new door for the initial green smoker and that I had changed the door and the gap was still there. The supervisors response was that a given amount of smoke was suppose to come out of the smoker. But you are not suppose to be able to see the grates and the food by looking into the gap in the door of the smoker. Then I explained that there was also a very large dent on the bottom of the smoker, as well. that issue was never addressed. Trying to work with Masterbuilt was like pulling nails out of something with my teeth. The smoker arrived new in the box with a large amount of yellow goo on the door and it looked like someone had tried to weld it back together. I was told to send them pictures three times and I complied each time. Masterbuilt sent Amazon defective units and then refused to replace the unit. I have two of the 40 inch Masterbuilt smokers and they do not have any gaps in them. I wanted the 30 inch for portability, but at this point, I will never buy form masterbuilt again. The unit cannot maintain the temperature if there is so much heat being lost through the big gap. Now get this, I plugged it up today after having been dealing with masterbuilt for about 2 weeks and it came on for approximately 15 minutes. Then it cut off and never came back on. Defective unit and masterbuilt will not take responsibility for their mistake. I purchased the unit less than 2 months ago. masterbuilt makes hundreds of these units, surely they understand some are going to be defective. If the unit was in good working condition, I would have been using it and not calling to complain. Be careful if you buy from masterbuilt, because if you have a problem they will not help. They will send you parts that you do not need. They also offered to send me parts that they told me I could switch out. I am 66 years old and if I wanted to build a smoker, I would not be on Amazon purchasing one. BEWARE!!!!

title: ambient weather station WS-2902C wifi smart weather station
text:
UPDATE below...
Pros:
* The outdoor unit does connect to the indoor unit and the screen is legible.
* The buttons (completely smooth - pressure sensitive) work. - but are also part of the cons below.
Cons:
* It comes in a million pieces - including extra pieces that apparently do go with the unit? A weird spring? (see pic) See UPDATE below in next item. It took a while, but I found out what it was. It's not in the huge manual.
* The instruction booklet is really awful and refers to items that don't go with this unit - NO instructions for extra pieces or even acknowledgment of them in the list of pieces (spring for example) UPDATE: Don't look for instructions - but I found info that it is poked into the center of the rain funnel to work as some sort of filter.. but it doesn't work. It just slows the rain from going down the funnel and doesn't stop any debris - at least not so far. So - stays in the CON pile.
* The instructions to connect the unit to wifi via your smart phone is HORRIBLE and doesn't work. If you're purchasing because it offers "wifi" buy something else. They don't provide an easy install QR or anything. It's just soooo much harder than it should be. Note: The flashing wifi symbol DOES stop flashing, contrary to what the "in the know" tech support "expert" told me. The fact it stops flashing is good and should be in the PRO column, but it's not enough to turn the tide here. Now, if you are a professional tech support person who specializes in wifi connectivity, you MIGHT succeed - but I would not lay money on it.
* The app is completely useless - I live relatively rurally. So it would not register my address. Instead, I was given a choice to choose someone else's address(es) all more than 30 miles from me for weather checks. What??? Yeah, the app is junk. Note to self... check the app BEFORE purchasing the unit. My bad.
* There is a tag in the box that offers an email and phone number for customer service. I tried the email. I sent the pertinent info regarding my phone, type etc.. all the things I had tried... etc. First response from email was... " What kind of phone are you using?" O.M.G. Don't bother unless you enjoy the frustration of someone representing customer service but really has no idea what they are doing.
* It does NOT come with a post of ANY kind - so purchase one. Also, NO batteries either.
* The indoor unit is great if you set it down and don't touch it. If you accidentally touch the bottom edge, you'll have to reset is at every point. GRRRRR
* Speaking of setting it down, it has some pop out legs AND a base that apparently do NOT work together. Good luck. I have yet to figure out a solid way to set it.
Conclusion for me.... I am looking for a different station. I don't care about the wifi part, so I'll be looking for something less technical maybe. It would be so nice if it didn't come in a million pieces and just worked. I purchased this one to replace a cheaper one that only lasted 9 months. Maybe I am meant to watch the TV weatherman.
UPDATE: 11/30/2020.... So, haven't owned this weather station for a month and now the outside temp and light monitor no longer reporting to the inside unit. This thing is a very expensive piece of junk. If I could drop to ZERO stars, I would.

title: microwave bacon cooker
text: My microwave is an over the stove - and it is narrow - not as tall as some microwaves inside. In the beginning of my search I was looking into the stand up versions - but they would not fit in my narrow height microwave.  So, I began looking at flat cookers.  I landed on this one.  I liked that it had a lid.  One of my top reasons to find one that worked was to minimize the mess in cooking it.  This one worked great.  Even though it notes that it is dishwasher safe, I do hand wash it, hoping to extend it's life.  I use the blue pre cleaning spray - works like a dream.  I put 5 pieces of regular thickness bacon (not thick and not extra thin).  4 minutes cooked the strips to my liking - cooked but not crispy.  On that note, I would not try to "crisp" bacon in the microwave - microwaves really aren't designed to crisp anything.  But if you like normal cooked bacon this will work.  One helpful hint I would share is to drain the oil in the bottom of the cooker while it is liquid.  Don't let it set - it is way too much work to scrape it out.  I do recommend hand washing.  And I really like that I am not cleaning up bacon splatter for days and my bacon is tasty.  I would recommend this cooker - but having said that I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

I put a little food grade diatomaceous earth in each canyon for an extra layer of confidence.  I chose these as they were reasonably priced and arrived quickly (I have prime).  They are tough.  I have a heavy, adjustable bed frame and they are holding up.  I do not have casters on my bed feet - just a post. I would suggest you check to see how many "feet" your bed has - most have more than 4, especially if it's an adjustable and larger (king size) bed - but if you only have one bed, one package should work - it contains 8 cups.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this info was helpful to you!

title: Interesting Yard decor... but nothing more
text:
I purchased this owl to try and deter ground squirrels from my herb box. I have pictures of them sitting right next to it. My little birds are not affected at all and that is good. I REALLY wanted this to work...
So, you unpack it. It's a good size, but it's very light weight. I placed it and stacked river rocks at the base so it wouldn't blow away in a good gust. As soon as I set in out the sun it the solar panel and the head began spinning like something out of the excorcist. I am pretty sure I've never seen an owl "naturally" move it's head like that... but what the heck, it moves. Also to note.... it makes a clunk sound right before it spins. And it spins at a fairly high speed. It does sort of bobble in the wind... a little. I had thought the movement would be effective... in theory... but my ground squirrels are just too smart. :)
Honestly, for $30 I should send it back as it clearly isn't a pest guard in any stretch of the imagination. But it is an funny yard trash element. Which is about the only reason to order it... or keep it.
I'm trying the "natural" smelly spray next. We'll see if that's more effective.

title: replacement for much older feeder
text:
I live right on the ocean front, Northern Oregon. Everything takes a beating here, year round with the salt air. My old aluminum feeder finally gave out. I was very nervous about ordering this one. It arrived in ok condition... however, the perches were all loose, flying round in the box. Weird that they weren't in a separate bag or something... but found them all and installed them. It holds 9 or 10 pounds of bird seed which is 10x the amount of my old one. Much less time refilling. I have it hanging on a really sturdy shepards style hook. Because of the weight with the seed in it, it's pretty stable. You unscrew the squirrel baffle top and fill it. I don't feed thistle seeds, but you can easily flip the feeder holes to support thistle seeds. The way the holes are designed and positioned, the seed really stays fairly well in the feeder, meaning it doesn't just pour out when the birds peck. There is also a catcher at the bottom for most seeds that fall out which is nice. There are tiny holes in the catcher to drain water. The shiny copper look strips on the feeder holes are interesting... at first the birds saw their reflections and were initially turned off by that... they quickly overcame their concerns. :) I have noticed that even when the stellar jays eat the feeder stays level. This all translates to less seed on the ground feeding the ground squirrels which is good.
Also note, the feeder is quite large/tall, I don't remember what is quoted on the description but the tube portion is a good 16- 20" tall and each tube is about 2 1/2 -3" in diameter. Which it would have to be to hold that much seed!
I will update if I have any wear or other issues. For now, I am thrilled. Hope this helps!

title: Convenient
text:
These disposable grills are awesome for a quick, easy bbq. They are perfect for "precooked" like hotdogs/brats. If you want to grill something raw, chicken/beef, I find a piece of foil over the top of cooking food is helpful to focus the heat. I love that the "charcoal" is all natural and no lighter fluid is necessary. I use the smaller size when it's just me. The larger size cooked 8 hotdogs and 4 brats easily (space). I also like the sanitary aspect of using these... no grill to clean or grilling on a surface that might not be cleaned well. NOTE: Beware of using the wire brushes on your grill - the metal brissles can be ingested and puncture your intestines - which is life threatening not to mention painful! When using a regular grill, once the grates have cooled you can soak the grill grates in garbage sack with a little detergent. Next day, hose them off. Yeah, it's a little more of a hassle, but NO metal brissles to ingest.
All in all, these disposable grills are really meant for "lightweight" grilling projects. I just like the additional positive aspects of using them, like the cleanliness aspect. Hope this info helps!

title: Paid for itself on first use
text:
I had a couple of large tree limbs snap during a storm. They were much too high for me to safely tackle with a ladder. Even with this 26' saw, they were right at the maximum cutting range. It was tricky to get the full-length saw vertical, due to poor leverage and other branches getting in the way. I made it work by resting the blade on lower branches, and steadily hopping it up higher. If I were to do it again, I would have gotten the saw in position with maybe 15' of handle attached. Then I would have hoisted it straight up and added pieces to the handle mid-use.

Once the saw was in position, it worked like a dream. The long blade allowed for big downward strokes, and the hook at the end of the blade kept it from sliding off of the limb. With the weight of the pole and the sharpness of the blade, gravity did most of the cutting work for me. I was not gentle on the blade (lots of bending on the way up/down). Even so, it held up fine, and is still straight. There is a cutting edge toward the handle side that is a bit mangled, but it still works fine. Also, they ship this thing with an extra blade, which is great.

I thought I would need to pay hundreds of dollars to a tree removal service. Instead, this did the job for a little over a hundred. Even better, I can use it again should the need arise. Great value, 10/10, highly recommend.

title: Good Strong Stream of Water; could use better wheels and a design change on hose winder
text: I would like to give this 5 stars, as it is a wonderful machine, but a few minor issues.  This is my first power washer and it seems to put out quite a powerful stream of water.  Some reviewers complained that it wasn't as powerful as other power washers they have owned.  I think it is powerful enough for most uses around the outside of a home.  It doesn't seem like it is intended as a commercial unit.  I really liked the fact that it is light enough to lift easily and move around without any difficulty.  The wheels didn't work quite as well as I had hoped; they are plastic and a little flimsy and wobbly.  Nice hard rubber tires would be a real improvement.  Assembly is minimal and easy, except that it is difficult to attach the cleaning hose.  It takes a bit of effort to get it threaded on to the machine and the sprayer handle.  The biggest downside is that the design is such that if you want to use the included cleaning hose winder for storage, you have to disconnect the cleaning handle; that would be okay, except for the difficulty in attaching it again, since it is hard to thread on.  I am concerned that if I use the machine much, eventually the threads will go bad with the constant detach/reattach.  Has a nice feature that it doesn't run when the cleaning handle trigger is not pressed.  The machine is not overly noisy.  Power cord seems to be a good length; of course you need an outside outlet to run this or one close to your doorways if you have to plug it in from the inside of your house.  I like the machine overall and it is so easy to operate.  I just wish they had put better wheels on it and changed the hose winder so that you don't have to detach one side.  Good machine for light to medium duty.  Great for cleaning around the outside of a home.

title: Faulty, died after 1.5 months.
text:
We do not have a complicated bird bath, and I kept it clean. This fountain kit was shifty from the start, our fountain only worked intermittently throughout each day. We cleaned the pump. We cleaned the solar panel. We moved the panel around. We tried everything possible. Even in direct sunlight this thing would not work perpetually.

Bought this June 20th. By August 5th it stopped working entirely.

The pump is really basic and not very good quality at all. Manufacturing probably cost them five cents in bulk at most. I cannot say for the solar panel, but that it cannot even maintain the fountain motor even with hours of direct sunlight does seem to indicate that the panel is very poor quality.

We will not buy from this company again. The fountain worked just long enough to guarantee that we could not get a refund.

title: Transformative- Plants seem to enjoy the lights
text:
We're so happy with our new lit shelves and I would not hesitate to recommend these lights to anyone. We have two wire rack shelves at polar opposite corners of our living room rather than traditional book cases. Over this winter we dedicated the top two shelves to many of our indoor plants to try to keep them alive under a grow bulb. For Spring, we decided that these shelves needed to be rigged better to support the life and growth of our indoor plants in this room, something more permanent and aesthetically pleasing.

The strip lights work so easily, and secure to our wire shelves with a zip tie. We have not fiddled with the timer yet so I cannot speak on that, however it's super easy to just manually turn them on. Because there are two light strips per controller, we split the light strips up one per shelf. Then we bought a third light for one extra shelf which now with both strips on it because that is where our indoor herb garden is now being set up.

It looks absolutely beautiful to see the plants lit up properly. It's become a stunning feature of our living room, and it did not cost much to set up. (It's hard to see, but we have cardboard panels which we also bought off Amazon and wrapped them in plastic painter's tarp to create a backsplash for misting the plants) Even our new herb shelf is thriving, and our seeds have just germinated under the strip lights!!

title: Make your own nectar! Better for birds
text:
Sturdy design your local hummingbirds will enjoy. Please PLEASE educate yourself before deciding to feed wild hummingbirds. It may be a bigger responsibility than you realize.
Your feeder will need cleaned thoroughly at least once a week in cooler months, and two times a week.
* Mold growth happens quickly, especially during warmer months and will make the birds sick and even kill them. Ants invade feeders, be aware that dead ants floating inside the feeder becomes toxic to birds.
For proper cleaning, never ever use any soap. Just warm water and scrub inside with a baby bottle brush. For the drinking ports, i use a straw brush.
Please never buy any hummingbird nectar mix with dye red coloring. Not necessary and bad for the birds. The red color of the feeder is all you need to bring them to your home. Dyes serve no purpose, and they’re harmful.
How to make your own nectar. Use 1 part sugar to 4 parts water.
In the summer, the nectar solution can become very hot when the sun shines on your feeder. Try to moving it to a shady spot or create some shade for it,

title: Do your research before buying a feeder!
text:
No complaints from the birds. I like the ease of filling it, as well as it’s easy to clean. I really like how many spots it has for the birds to drink from.
PLEASE do your research before buying a feeder and as well on how to “properly” feed the birds, clean the feeder and the nectar you make. Never add more sugar than needed. It’s very bad for the birds. I use 1 part sugar to 4 parts water. So I cup of sugar and 4 cups of water. If ants become an issue, take care of it swiftly. Dead ants in the water will contaminate the water very quickly. Most hummingbird won’t like to drink when this happens, but it also can make them very sick. My feeder is hanging from a long wood piece I hammered into my wood fence.
When ants make their way to my feeder, I remove the feeder, spray a ant/ bug spray along the fence and half way onto the stick I hang the feeder from. It works for about 6 weeks to deter them from finding their way to my feeder. Always remove the feeder first, and never spray the feeder or anywhere the birds perch. Hope this helps some of you. In the summer, I get an average of 20-30 birds at once all day long coming to my 4 feeders. I live in California, so we get a lot of hummies.

title: End caps may unscrew over time, especially in high winds.
text: The spinners are designed to rotate counter clockwise when mounted as shown in the photos.  The twist on end caps that keep the spinners on the shaft use standard clockwise threads.  This means that whenever the the spinners move, there is a constant slight pressure to unscrew the end caps.  On a very windy day one side did unscrew and push the spinners, spacer, and end cap out onto the ground.  Owners should check to see if the end caps have come loose periodically, especially in high winds.  I would consider this a design flaw.  I think the spinners should have been designed to also rotate clockwise to avoid this problem.

title: Gift your child seeds and a cute planter instead.
text:
I've been familiar with the Aerogarden name for years since I used to work in retail, and thought it was a cute idea when I saw they now had a line of Aerogarden kits aimed at kids - what could be more fun than growing your own pizza herb garden?

The first thing I noticed when I unboxed it was the cheap build quality .

Also, the kit comes with many small parts (dropper, seeds. etc,), so depending on the age of your kids, this is definitely something to be unboxed / explored with supervision.

Many buyers reported receiving kits with missing parts (missing seeds, dropper, plant food, etc.), so you may want to check your box to make sure everything is inside before wrapping (I had no issues with mine).

I did like the growing guide / activity book, which lets your kids track the progress as their herbs grow. There are also ideas and recipes for hosting a pizza party using the herbs in the kit.

I can see the use / appeal of this in some environments (no windows / no balcony / not enough natural light / no garden to grow herbs on a windowsill or traditional way, but overall this seems more like a marketing gimmick and I feel like kids will be just as happy playing in the dirt rather than trying to use the included seeds, soil, domes, dropper, etc.

title: A little unwieldy, but they get the job done...
text:
The Corona SL 4264 loppers are longer and heavier than other loppers that we have used. Because of that they initially seemed a little unwieldy. Using them could probably become tiring if you had to work with them continuously for long period of time. However, we have only used them for small jobs trimming the bushes and trees around our home, so they have been fine for us.

These Corona loppers are probably closer to being a "real" tool than our other loppers (Fiskars). The SL 4264 loppers are well designed and solidly built. The blades on them are aligned well and are very sharp, which enables us to cut thicker branches than we could with our other loppers. We used to use a pruning saw to cut branches that were over 1", but the Corona loppers can handle those up to 1 1/2" at least. These loppers make a clean and smooth cut. The comfort grip handles make the loppers easy on the hands.

We have seen reviews of Corona loppers that stated that these tools weren't as well made or as durable as they were in the past. We have no plans to give our loppers enough heavy duty use to really put them to the test. They seem to be more than durable enough for our occasional use of them.

title: Not satisfied
text: This was quite possibly the worst buy I've done in a long time, the pots themselves have no issues and are very easy to understand on how to assemble them. The instructions are clear and easy to follow, quick and even fun to get set up, but that's about as far as it goes. The earth used for these pots is unnaturally wet, it does state on the package that it is different from normal soil and whatnot but I'd expect it to at the very least help me grow a few small seedlings. I planted two different seeds on each one of these and it has been I'd say probably about a month or longer since I got them set up and I have yet to see any plants come out of these, like at all, when in fact I did happen to see one small sprout coming out and it was gone in literally a day I have no idea what happened to it or why it disappeared literally from one night to the next morning but it was gone and I have not seen any other sprouts from any of the both of them, needless to say I let a long time pass after that it's probably been over 2 weeks since and nothing, no other seed sprouted and I planted a few of them on each so I don't know what happened. The soil got so moist at a certain point I am sure one of the pots developed some sort of fungus or the like the type of white covering you get when the soil is moist for too long and it never dries out either. The other pot actually did not develop any problems but I noticed an actual spider decided to start making a spider web on it because it literally never grew anything... I am giving this 2 stars because the soil it includes just literally sucks and doesn't work at all, I feel like I've wasted my time and energy watering seeds that I planted on these for no reason, wasted need seeds that I am never getting back, and you should avoid doing what I did probably, I have no idea what would happen with a live plant but my guess is it would probably be too wet all the time and similar problems may occur.

I guess you could say that they are alright.

title: Works, but get the stuff for outside too.
text:
So I didn't know I had an ant problem until I bought these traps. I would see the occasional ant here or there but I hated that I would be relaxing and out of the corner of my eye, an ant! So I bought 2 of these, for a total of 24 traps, yikes! Well I'm down 12 already! The thing is, since the ants were always literally in any part of the house, even just one, I didn't know where to set the traps. So I went with all door entry points and by the windows I had seen them before. SO MANY ANTS DIED INSIDE MY HOUSE. and in that little wedge by deck door.cant say I'm upset as it fixed the problem.. Sort of. I must have another few colonies outside because they came back, just a little location change.

My recommendations would be to get 2 of these to start, and to maintain, but also get the outside traps, so that they die outside. This way you keep them away from inside your house, and off your property as a whole.

title: Holds my plants without taking up much room
text: I love the portability as I can move to different windows for natural light. The convenient cover has a zipper flap and the shelves are easy to attach grow lights to, with zip ties.

text: The quality of this cover is good. The material is not too thin. There are some well thought out features such as the accessory storage pouch. It's just too big for our generator. title: Excellent Quality
text: This is a beautiful door mat. It's also an excellent quality. Unfortunately, it doesn't fit on our front porch. It's about 2 inches too long. It's very thick, too, and when we tried it out on the porch, it interfered with the opening and closing of the storm door.

title: Plant Based Cleaner
text: I prefer to use plant based cleaners when I can. The only exceptions for me are when dealing with raw meat in the kitchen or cleaning the toilets. We bought a new hot tub during the pandemic. There aren't a lot of products out there designed specifically for hot tubs, let alone natural ones. This one doesn't smell chemically. It's actually a very light, pleasant smell. I haven't used it in the entire tub since we just drained and refilled it right before it arrived, but we have used it around the top. We don't have a lot of build up on the tub surface, but it did make it look cleaner with a little bit of shine. I am happy with it.

title: Nicer Than Expected
text: This Grinch themed door mat is much nicer than I expected. It isn't cheap looking at all. It lays flat also immediately after taking it out of the packaging. It's really a great mat! It's not plush, but it's still absorbent. The images are well done, too.

title: Disappointing
text: I love decorating for Halloween. I had seen some of these in pictures and wanted to try it. Unfortunately I found it to be disappointing. It arrived right before Halloween, so I didn't have a lot of time to see it in action. In the short time that we did have it up, it never blew in the wind like we had hoped it would. Then the morning after Halloween, it was completely on the ground. It was still intact, but on the grass. I think the biggest issue is the plastic pole. What little wind we did have wasn't enough to get the ghoul into a flying position, but it was enough to warp or bend the pole! A metal pole would have stayed up better. The ghoul is poseable to an extent. The mask was probably the best part of it. I think you really have to shell out the money for a quality one to get the desired look.

title: Halloween Inflatable
text: This trio of witches is a fun Halloween inflatable. It inflated easily. It did require using all of the stakes and rope that was included in order to keep them upright. We set it up on a pretty windy day which was helpful to us so we were able to secure them well. We've had a few rainy days since they were installed and they've held up well. The lights work fine. Overall, we are satisfied.

title: Halloween Inflatable
text: I love decorating for Halloween. This is a fun Halloween inflatable for out front lawn. It was easy to inflate. It comes with stakes and rope. There are many loops around the bottom so you can secure it to the ground. Because it's narrow, it does have a tendency to lean over, so be sure to use all the stakes and rope.

title: Wonderful Christmas Inflatable!
text: This is a wonderful Christmas inflatable. It's unique and fun looking. Did I mention that it's huge? Well, it is pretty big, too! My husband and I enjoy putting up an assortment of inflatables at Christmas time. This will make a nice addition to the ensemble. I tried it out in the house and it works well - of course, only time will tell. I'm hoping to get multiple seasons from it.

title: Great Halloween Decor
text: We love decorating for Halloween. I have a similar spider web already, but I wanted another one for an even creepier look this year. The spider web is pretty good. I had one for the last few years and gradually the web started to fall apart. I think that's just a normal thing because we keep it outside for a good month or so. I don't mind having to replace the web every few years. What I really like about this one that the others haven't had is that this comes with a hook and ground stakes that make it easier to set up. The spider is pretty cool! It also comes with the stretchy spider web that you can spread out over things, too. From my experience, that's something that only gets used once when used outside. But I do like adding it to the bushes and the mailbox for added effect. Overall,  I am very pleased with this Halloween decor!

title: Huge!
text: This guy is huge! He is going to look great in our front yard cemetery this Halloween. I tested it out in the living room and I was very impressed with him. It took a little longer to inflate than some of the other inflatables I've gotten, but because of the size, it's really not a surprise. The LED lights inside add to the spookiness!

title: Cool Halloween Decor!
text: Visually, these spider egg sacks are pretty cool. It's a unique decoration! There are a couple of things that would improve these. The light feature works. However, it's not easy to access, especially if you're hanging these. A remote control would be very convenient. There are 3 different modes for the light which is fun. Another thing, I'm not sure how well they'll hold up to the weather outside. I usually throw out the cotton like spider webs that I arrange all over the bushes. I'll have to wait to see how these do after being outside for a month. If they don't hold up well, then it's a bit pricey for such a short term item. In order to keep them longer, I may just keep them on the porch where they're not directly out where the rain can get them.

title: Halloween Ghosts
text: My family goes all out at Halloween. We love decorating our yard for the month. I had some similar ghosts last year that needed replacing, so I ordered these. Yes, the ones from last year need to be replaced already. In my personal experience, these last only one season when you keep them outdoors. At least in areas where you get rain. By the end of October, the white cloth had mildew spots all over. I even removed all the white gauzy material and washed it to no avail. After examining these, I expect them to have the same issue. Of course, if the month is dry, I may be pleasantly surprised. But please don't let that dissuade you from ordering these. They really are cute. And they look great hanging from trees! The faces are all different. Their arms can be bent somewhat for shaping. Of course if you hang them up inside, they'll last much longer.

title: Awesome Halloween Inflatable!
text: This is an awesome Halloween inflatable! It will make a great addition to our Halloween yard decorations. It inflates easily. It comes with stakes and ropes. I really like the details on this one! We've been putting up inflatables for the last 4 years. We have learned that ones that are wider and lower to the ground such as this one, usually require less maintenance when they're inflated. Ones that are tall and skinny will fall over in heavy winds and have to have adjustments made to keep them upright. I am very happy with this!

title: Decent Door Mat
text: My door mat was looking pretty rough and needed replacing. This one isn't fancy, but it does the job. It seems to be durable. It's absorbent. I like the neutral design.

title: It Works!
text: We tend to get little flying insects in the house. I can't stand them! Usually it seems to be just one or two at a time, but they fly around all the time and are very annoying. I put one of these on the kitchen window and within an hour, there was one of the tiny insects on it. The trap has a thin adhesive strip that goes on the window. The other side is entirely sticky to catch the bugs. It's easy to remove from the window. I am impressed. It works!

title: Just What I Wanted
text: A couple of years ago, I got a large spider web to include in our Halloween yard display. The spider web lasted 2 to 3 years, but after last Halloween, I threw it out because too many of the ropes had fallen apart and it was losing its shape. This web looks just like the old one and will work well. I don't expect it to last more than a few years because it will be kept outside for a month at a time. This web comes with 4 large spiders. They're actually medium sized in my opinion. The one that came with our old web was much larger. I actually like this size better. And with 4 spiders, we can have some fun with the decorating. I am very pleased with this.

title: Really Cute!
text: This is a unique and fun Halloween inflatable. Before I even got it, I knew it could potentially be troublesome. It doesn't stand up on its own very well. It will definitely require lots of rope ties and staking to get it to stay in place. From previous experience with other inflatables, we will position it so it's close to something that can help shield it from strong winds. We have become used to having to adjust or stand up certain types of inflatables that often get knocked over in windy conditions. I tried this out in our living room. Be sure to zip it up prior to inflating or else you'll lose all the air. Also, one of the my skeletons was twisted a lot at his foot which caused the air to only inflate one skeleton and not both until I discovered the problem and untwisted his legs multiple times. They look great! I am very excited to add this to our Halloween yard display!

title: Awesome!

This coccoon corpse is awesome! He is going to look great in our display. He's very light weight so he will be easy to hang. Right now I have him hanging on a hook inside the house and one of my cats has been very suspicious of him! I am very impressed with this guy and look forward to adding him to our yard!

In retrospect, my husband says he should have laid everything out before putting it together. The directions weren't great. He has put together a lot of IKEA stuff and thinks highly of the instructions that IKEA gives. These were definitely not up to par with IKEA. He was able to figure it out and the finished chair is very nice and sturdy. I think the whole thing took him about 40 minutes when it should have taken much less.

title: Great Way to See the Birds Up Close
text: This bird feeder is a great way to see the birds up close. My daughter put this on the outside of her kitchen window. It was easy to set up. The suction cups work well. There's not a lot of room for lots of bird seed, so it does require frequent refilling. I think that's probably the case with other similar feeders. My daughter has been enjoying watching the birds!

title: A Fun Way to Feed the Hummingbirds
text: We get hummingbirds for at least 4 months every year. We really enjoy watching them. This new feeder is a fun way to feed them. We have it where we can get a good view of them. So far the suction cups have been holding it up fine.

title: Works Well!
text: We usually don't have too much trouble with ants and our hummingbird feeder, but we thought this wouldn't hurt. Our daughter took an ornithology class last semester at college and told us about a hummingbird who had gotten its tongue bitten by an ant. The ant had to be forcibly removed from the bird. We promised her we would take preventative measures, so when this showed up, we immediately put it up. It is made of metal which surprised me. It's definitely a quality piece. It was easy to add to our hummingbird feeder. It is working well as there were no ants in the feeder when we filled it up this week.

title: Wow!
text: Wow! I thought we were doing a decent job of cleaning our hot tub filter. After using this, we're not so sure. The directions are straight forward and easy to use. After the cleaning process is done, our filter looked brand new! We have 2 filters and we rotate back and forth between them. I'm sure this cleaner will add life to both of them.

title: These are great!
text: My daughter has been packing her belongings to move into an apartment at college later this month. These bags have been great for this! They have a large capacity. The material is durable and sturdy. It's easy to transport because of the handles. These bags are clear so you can actually see what's packed inside.

title: Adorable!
text: I recently redid my home office. I ordered this sun catcher to go in my office window. It looks adorable there! I love the pink & green colors. There are some pink crystals hanging down as legs. I am using the suction cup that came with it, but it came with an adhesive piece for hanging, too. I love that this is from a small shop in Ukraine! This would me a great gift!

title: Garden Fun!
text: This garden Dinosaur & Gnomes makes a fun addition to our back yard! We have it located by the patio. The solar ball just adds to the overall appeal. It's well made and it looks great!

title: Save the Animals!
text: It always makes me sad to see a dead creature in the pool. I'm hoping that this solves that problem. The unit is a little larger than I expected. It requires inflating a small tube. A small pump is included. I recommend that you put the tube inside the ramp base before inflating! Otherwise you will need to deflate it and try again. There is nothing included to weigh down the top portion that stays on the pool deck, so we had to find something to put inside that. Let's save the animals!

title: Good Quality
text: We keep our flag outside all the time. Our flags tend to fray and fade after a few months of use. My husband, a former Boy Scout and former Boy Scout leader, likes to replace our flag before it gets too faded.  This one is a good quality and nice looking.  The stars are embroidered. The stripes are securely stitched together. We will take our old one to the local Boy Scout troop which holds flag retirement ceremonies a few times each year.

title: Super Easy!
text: I have 3 cats and they all like to eat grass. This arrived the day before I was going out of town. While I was away, my husband got it set up and "planted" the grass. When I got home, a week later, I was surprised to see full grown grass! It was super easy to get started! The planter and grass looks nice, too. My cat that's eating the grass the most, tends to make a mess and leave grass strands all over the floor. I have this sitting on the kitchen floor next to the food bowls. I'm glad refills are available for purchase!

title: Bird Approved
text: The birds seem to like this bird seed. The bag is on the small size, but the mix of seeds is good. One bag nearly filled my bird feeder, so it's not going to last long. It's bird approved, so that's a good thing.

title: We Already Have Bluebird Residents!
text: We bought a bluebird house a few years ago and have had multiple residents. Now we have this one, so we can accommodate more of them. This house is very well made. It's quite sturdy and seems to be durable. The wax coating is a nice feature. Our other one has faded a lot from the sun and weather. Maybe that won't be an issue with this one.  The wax did make it difficult to open the house, but my husband used a screwdriver, I think, and was able to pop it open. I like that there's a clear acrylic window. I probably won't utilize that unless we're trying to see if the home is vacant so we can remove the nest to make way for the next bird family. The clear window does have a wood cover so it's not visible all the time so the birds do get their privacy. My husband posted it on a metal tube in the back of the yard. I am very impressed with this house.

title: Great Cushions!
text: These are great cushions! They are nice and thick. They have ties to attach to your existing chairs. I love the sage color!

title: Great Color!
text: We needed new cushions for our outdoor dining set. These are a decent thickness, but they do compress a lot when you're sitting down on them. We have found that we can't sit on them for too long (hours) because we can feel the metal bars of the chair frame underneath after a while. The sewing looks good. They have ties to secure them to the chair. It's definitely an improvement over the sad, saggy old ones we had.

title: Great Plant Stand!
text: This plant stand requires some assembly. It was easy to put it together. The finished stand is very sturdy and it looks great. You can fit 2 plants on this - one on the top and one on the lower level. It doesn't take up a lot of space. I am very happy with it.

title: Cute Garden Decor
text: This crane garden statue is cute! It requires some assembly. It's not super sturdy, but it's okay. It does come with some stakes to secure it to the ground. It looks great!

title: Fun!
text: My daughter saw a similar product online and wanted it. She loves the idea of seeing the birds close up. Set up was pretty easy. I downloaded the app on my phone. I was immediately able to see the feeder. At first we attached it to one of our trees. The squirrels found it to be a great location! So we moved it to the deck. Still, we only got squirrels. Then my husband got a metal pole from the garage. He attached a piece of wood to the top. Then he attached this to the pole. He put it in the middle of the yard, away from any trees. The darn squirrels shimmied up the pole without any difficulties. We need to grease the pole or something. We also need to replace the food as the squirrels have eaten it all. The system does work as it should. I haven't been able to use the identify feature yet as we haven't captured any birds on it yet. The camera unit has a cable so you can charge it. The one that my daughter saw which inspired her to have one of these, used solar power to charge it. That would probably be better as you wouldn't have to take out the camera to charge it. We're not giving up on this, we just need to work at keeping the squirrels away. Though we do find it amusing when the squirrels are on it!

title: Huge!
text: We had an umbrella for our table, but a few months ago it got damaged. My husband and I enjoy sitting out on the deck in the evenings and with the sunset so late because of the time of year, we find ourselves changing seats to avoid the direct light. This umbrella is huge! It provides so much more shade then the one that fit on the table. We did have to rearrange the furniture out there first because this takes up some space. It didn't take very long for my husband to put it together. The directions were pretty clear. My husband plans to secure the base of it directly to the deck since it doesn't come with a weighted base.

title: No Refrigeration!
text: We have a few hummingbirds who frequent us from about April until early fall. I like the convenience of pre-made food for them. This one is especially nice because it requires no refrigeration! I filled the feeder yesterday and we have already seen our little visitors drinking it.

title: Fun Little Set!
text: This is a fun little set to have for families who get visits from the tooth fairy. It comes with the door, ladder, welcome mat, glitter, and a foot print stencil. The quality of items is decent. The details are fun!

title: Great Idea!
text: My first reaction to seeing this is "what a great idea!". This is going to be a huge time saver. Of course, it's not berry picking season yet, so I can't try it out. But I did take it out in the yard just to get a feel for how it would work and I don't see why it wouldn't. I'm just wondering why I haven't seen something like this before now!

title: Cute Cat!
text: We're a cat family, so when I saw this metal cat statue, I had to order it! It's really nice. It's sturdy and very cute. He or she has some "purr-sonality". This would make a great gift for your favorite cat lady!

title: Beautiful!
text: What a beautiful outdoor spinner! It's very colorful. It was easy to put together. When the wind blows, it spins. I have enjoyed watching it! We did have to move it away from the bird feeders so it wouldn't frighten the birds away!

title: Nice!
text: My son just graduated from college. I thought this would be a nice decoration to celebrate. The pieces are sturdy. You do have to insert the stakes, but it was easy enough to do. There are smaller stakes so you can add pieces on top of others if desired. I didn't use everything, but what I did looked nice. My husband did have to use some duct tape to keep the pieces that we added to other pieces from moving. Otherwise, the wind kept blowing them so they weren't visible. Overall, we were pleased with it.

title: Easy to Put Together
text: I ordered this as decor for my patio area. It was very easy to put together. The directions were clear. The Bees look a little too cutesy in my opinion, but it's okay. It had no problem going into the dirt. It definitely adds some cheeriness to my patio area.

title: Beautiful!
text: This cardinal stained glass is beautiful! It's sturdy and feels like a good quality. It fits nicely in the window. The suction cup and hook work, but I have other similar hooks which seem better made. No worries for now since it's working fine. It doesn't give any indication that it might fall, but only time will tell. This would make a great gift!

title: Just What We Wanted!
text: My husband sets up a booth at a few trade shows each year. The Chicago one provides 4 foot tables at that event space. We have 6 foot table cloths, just like this one, but since they're not the right size, it never looks perfect. Now we have a table cloth that's the right size! I was impressed with the difference it makes! It is very easy to put on the table but it looks more polished and professional.

title: Sturdy
text: The first thing I noticed is that this bird feeder is larger than I expected. It's sturdy and well made. We set up multiple bird feeders. We have quite the variety. None of ours look like this at all. I like the cage around it. I'm not sure if it will truly keep the squirrels out. The squirrels in our yard are very clever!! I don't have any problems with the design restricting some of the birds from it. We have so many bird feeders that no one is getting left out! It's no easier or harder to clean than the others. We try to clean ours with a bleach/water solution once or twice a month. If it was too difficult, we would probably stop using it.

title: Trendy Bar Items
text: This home bar smoker kit is quite trendy. Smoked cocktails are very popular right now and with this set, you can do it at home. There are 4 different varieties of wood chips and a little chimney that fits over a standard glass. Definitely a fun thing to do at Happy Hour!

title: Will Be Great!
text: This handrail will be great after my husband is able to finish installing it. There is no hole for the knob to go into, so right now, he has the top piece inserted into the pole, but it wobbles and moves because it can't be tightened. The manufacture is aware of this issue because they say this in their description: "After receiving the package, if you find that part of the product is not punched, you can punch it yourself and contact the seller for compensation." Also, there were no instructions included. I was able to show my husband the picture on the product description and he could see how it is supposed to go. I can tell that it's going to be a good addition to our hot tub. The pieces are hefty and it seems to be sturdy.

title: We're Still Practicing
text: During the pandemic, we started making homemade pizza. It quickly became a family favorite. We would make it in the oven on a steal piece. We like our crust to have those charred bubbles on the bottom and have some crispiness to it. We've tried this pizza oven once and the results were just so-so. We followed the recipe that came with it. The dough was easy to make. Our usual pizza recipe calls for Bread flour, but this one called for AP Flour, so that's what we did. We used a blow torch to light the wood pellets. We tried using a kitchen torch for cream brulee when we first set it up and that wasn't enough to get it lit. The blow torch is the way to go. We have had difficulties getting the oven to maintain a high enough temperature to cook the pizza. We burnt a couple of them from flames coming overhead. The bottom of the dough wasn't browned or charred at all. The burnt ones did get charred edges. There's definitely a learning curve and we're still practicing. We see the potential of it.  We aren't giving up just yet.

title: They're Sprouting!
text: I have one of those indoor hydroponic gardens. I started out growing several different herbs, but we really only used the basil. So this time, I thought I would try growing only basil. With this, I am growing a few different varieties of the plant. It only takes a few seeds for my garden, but I think they're all sprouting now. The hydroponic garden is pretty fast growing, so I would imagine it won't be too long before I'm able to start using my fresh basil. I am very pleased with these seeds so far.

title: Bird Seed Cakes
text: These bird seed cake assortment are much easier to put out for the birds than loose seeds in the feeders. With that being said, they don't seem to be quite as popular as the feeders. There are some birds eating these seed cakes, so they must like it.

title: The Birds Like It
text: These bird seed cakes look like they're a good quality. You can see the various seeds and nuts easily - they're not disguised. I've seen several different birds enjoying them, so they must like them. There are 12 seed cakes in this set.

title: Popular with the Birds
text: These bricks of bird food aren't really suet. As far as I can tell, they're just pressed bird seed/meal worms. Nonetheless, the birds seem to be enjoying these. I was pleased that they didn't crumble very much when removing the plastic wrap. I've had some that just fall apart and make a mess. These retained their shape pretty well.

title: Great Quality!
text: A co-worker of mine uses a wagon whenever she needs to bring a lot of stuff to work. I've always envied it and how convenient it seemed. After getting to work, she would empty it and fold it up and store it out of the way. Now I have one and I am very pleased with it. It's a great quality -very sturdy and durable. It is easy to set up and fold down. It can hold a lot of  stuff. The wheels work well. I wish I hadn't waited so long to get my own!

title: Great Quality!
text: We have owned a few different pop up tents over the years. Depending on how much you use them, they seem to last just a few years in our experience. We had one tent that only lasted a season, but we were using it a lot and it was a cheap one to begin with. This one is a great quality. It's very sturdy. I would say it's definitely one of the better ones we've had. I like that it comes with removable walls. Most of our tents haven't had walls, so the first time we had one with them, we realized how beneficial they can be. They can provide privacy as well as protection from weather. Set up is straight forward. It looks nice when it's assembled.

title: Beautiful
text: These metal heron statues are beautiful! They are a great addition to our patio area. They require a little assembly. The legs have to be attached to the body. Then there are metal stakes to stake it to the ground and make it stable.

title: Quality Item
text: I saw this and thought it would be a fun addition to our back yard. My husband saw this and was worried it would be a poor quality item. Luckily, I was right and he was wrong. As he was putting it together, he told me that this was a quality piece. It's sturdy and well constructed. It's all metal. He really expected some of the pieces such as the end caps to be plastic. Assembly was easy. I think it took him less than 10 minutes. We haven't had a lot of wind since we installed it, but we have had enough to get some spinning. We haven't had much sun since we put this out, so the battery isn't getting a lot of charging to operate the light for very long. We are very happy with this!

title: Great Addition to My Holiday Decor
text: These gift boxes are a great addition to my holiday decor. I decided to put them outside rather than inside. The main reason is that they left glitter everywhere!! I am not a fan of glitter. The boxes require assembly, but it's really easy. I didn't even have to refer to the directions. They are realistic sizes for presents. They look great, unlit and lit. I am pretty happy with them.

title: Very Cute
text: A couple of years ago, we started putting out holiday inflatables at Halloween & Christmas. I like adding to them each year. This Santa & reindeer driven sleigh is very cute and fun! I tried it out in the house to make sure it worked properly. We won't put it out in the yard until after Thanksgiving. It worked as expected. It was fully inflated within a couple of minutes, tops. The reins & reindeer were a bit tangled up. It would have been easier to get them positioned properly BEFORE inflating. Once done, it looked great! It comes with stakes to secure it to the ground. The fan motor noise is comparable to other inflatables.

title: Faulty Fan
text: I was so excited for this unique Christmas inflatable! It's very cute. However, we received a dud. The LED lights came on, but the fan was faulty. Upon examination, the fan was barely moving and not making any sounds. But since the lights were working, we knew that the power brick wasn't the problem. My husband poked and prodded but didn't find any obvious fix for it. We have been putting out holiday inflatables for the past few years and have several. We have never had any arrive DOA. What a disappointment!

title: Good Variety of Bird Seed
text: My first reaction when I saw this bag of birdseed was that it was a little on the small side. I didn't think it would even fill my 2 bird feeders. I have 2 tube style feeders. One has a much wider diameter than the other. I'm guessing it's about 4 or 5 inches wide and at least 24 inches if not more in height. The other one is much thinner and shorter with a width of about 2 inches. Surprisingly, this bag was able to fill both feeders to about 80% capacity. The seed itself looks fine. There's a good variety of seeds. The birds (mostly cardinals, chickadees, blue birds, and finches right now) have been seen on the feeders, so I am assuming that they approve. I imagine the feeders will be empty by the middle of next week.

title: Great Halloween Decoration!
text: I had a similar spider web for the past 2 years, but when I was putting it up this year, I noticed that the web was beginning to deteriorate and wouldn't last another year. So when Halloween was over, I threw the web out. I opened this one up to inspect and compare it before I put it away for next year. The web material seems to be the same as the previous one. So I expect to get at least 2 years from it. I like the shape of this web better. It's more of a triangle shape where as the other one more of a circle. This shape will be more natural looking and work nicely with the tree where we put it at. The spider on this one does not make any sounds or movement. The old one did however, it was motion sensitive and we usually kept it off all the time. This spider folds well for storage. In addition to the large web and spider, there are 2 sets of the regular stretchy spider web. I usually use a bag each year, so I am pleased to have this for next year. I am very happy with this set. It is comparable if not better than the one we had. Now it goes in one of the Halloween tubs until next October.

title: Festive!
text: I am all about decorating for the holidays! I plan to put these candy canes in the flower bed along the sidewalk. These work well and I'm pleased with the finished product. However, there were no instructions at all. It wasn't very difficult to put together, but it did involve a little trial and error. They are very festive and will be a great addition to our Christmas decor.

title: Hilarious!!
text: We have love decorating our yard for Halloween. We have many tombstones that we have made over the years. They all have either a zombie ground breaker in front of them or a scattering of bones. This one is hilarious! He moans & moves! He actually crawls. In each cycle, he moves an inch or two forward. We actually keep him turned off most of the time so he doesn't leave the yard! We haven't quite figured out what triggers him, whether it's loud noises or motions because he's inconsistent. He's a little smaller than the other zombie ground breakers, but not too small that it looks out of place. He really adds a whole new element to our decorations!

title: Great for Small Spaces
text: Patio furniture prices are absurd! I've been looking for a set of chairs for our patio and they were in the vicinity of $300 per chair! This set is definitely affordable. The quality isn't too bad either. I was a little concerned when it arrived because it looked to small. You have to put it together. Assembly was pretty straight forward. The furniture is adult sized which was a relief! I was a little worried! It's also fairly sturdy. I'm a plus size woman and I feel safe while sitting on them. It's probably not what we want long term, but for the time being it's fine. It would be great for small spaces such as an apartment balcony or patio.

title: Very Sturdy
text: I am loving this swinging bench! My husband and I got one for a wedding present, 30 years ago (long gone by now), so having this one is very nostalgic. It took my husband about  an hour tops to put it together. I helped a little bit by holding things, but he did most of the work. The pieces were labeled well. The directions were not too bad. He put it together loosely, then after it was all in place, he went back and tightened everything. Right now we're keeping it on the patio under the deck, but we'll probably move it into the yard sometime. It's very sturdy. I'm a plus size woman and I don't feel like it's going to break or anything. The little pockets on the sides are a nice touch. We didn't know what they were at first. Overall, we're very happy with it.

title: Cute Outdoor Christmas Decor
text: Our Halloween decorations are out now, but it won't be long before the Christmas stuff goes out. I put these Christmas solar lights out on the deck to try them out. There's a protective covering on the solar panel to remove. Then on the back of the solar panel is a on/off switch. The stars light up on the stakes. While activated the light allows the snowman, Santa, or reindeer be lit up. There is a little bit of assembly required. The stakes are 2 parts. The paint job is good. The overall quality seems good, but of course, only time will tell. I do think that these are a bit pricey for what you get.

title: Great Addition to Our "Cemetery"
text: This zombie ground breaker is a great addition to our "cemetery". We have an assortment of tombstones and ground breakers all over our front yard right now. This guy works very well. Under his shirt, where his torso would be, he has a stand. We used metal tent stakes to secure him to the ground and that seems to be working well. We have him turned on because it would require removing the stakes to turn him off. Luckily, he's not too sensitive to sounds so we don't have to deal with him "coming to life" too frequently. At the same time, a really loud clap does activate him. He sways back and forth and moans. His eyes light up too.

title: Works Well
text: My husband and I love decorating for Halloween. I had planned to put this guy outside in our *cemetery*, but he's much smaller than I anticipated. I didn't pay attention to the measurements when ordering. I was hoping he was closer to the size of our ground breakers so he would fit in. I will put him on the porch on Halloween night though. He works well. His voice is clear and easy to understand. Hes' fun to watch. I do think he's a bit expensive for his size. That's usually the price we pay for the larger battery operated ground breakers.

title: Spooky Eyes!
text: I love decorating the yard for Halloween. These spooky eyes add some fun to the yard. They are battery powered (batteries not included). While there are advantages to having battery operated decorations, it's also a pain. It gives you more flexibility as to where you put it, but usually the batteries will have to be replaced at least once. With items that are plugged in, we use a timer so we control when they come on and turn off. This does have a timer button, but it would be nicer if it was in sync with the other items. The lights are colorful and they do look good.

title: Boo!
text: My husband and I love to decorate the yard for Halloween. We've had some zombie groundbreakers in our display in the past, but this brings it to a whole new level! This guy moves and makes sounds. Because of that, we have been keeping him turned off for the most part. I don't want to frighten the delivery guys! When activated, he kind of sways side to side. He moans and says some phrases. His LED eyes shine, too. It's really a fun addition to our display. He does require batteries, which are not included.

title: Batteries Not Included
text: These ghosts have LED lights that change colors. The lights require batteries (not included). They are connected together and each one is on a stake so you can stick it in the ground. They're not very big, but they are a fun addition to our outdoor Halloween display.

title: Sturdy!
text: This wooden bench requires hardly any assembly. It just folds out and then you latch the seat into place. It's very sturdy. I am a plus size woman and it didn't creak or sway when I sat down on it. It looks great. We have it in the front yard right now, but plan to move it out in the back soon. My husband and I actually found it to be comfortable to sit on. In the spring I may see about getting a cushion for it, but it would be more for looks. Our winters are pretty mild, so I'm not worried about it too much getting damaged by the weather, but we do plan to keep it under the deck on the patio during the winter. My husband is pleased with the quality of this, so that's pretty important.

title: Fun!
text: We just put out all of our outdoor Halloween decorations. This set of skulls has a place by the sidewalk leading to the front steps. When motion is detected, they start opening/closing their mouths, their eyes light up and they speak. I can't for the life of me figure out what they're saying, but they're fun nonetheless.

title: Squirrel Approved!
text: This squirrel feeder doesn't come with any instructions. I wasn't sure how to put it together. I figured something out, but I'm still not confident that I did it correctly. I filled it with raw peanuts. I have yet to see a squirrel eating from this, but someone has! There's probably less than a quarter of the peanuts left. So for that reason, I declare this squirrel approved!

title: Easy to Pose
text: This is a set of 4 hanging ghosts. The ghosts are small. I hung all 4 of them in my Crepe Myrtle tree along with a ghost that's about twice the size. The arms of the ghosts are easy to pose. Each ghost has a different face/expression. The white fabric is much shorter in the back than in the front. That's not necessarily a problem, but when the wind blows, some of them have the tendency to face the wrong way. Overall, these are a fun addition to our Halloween decor.

title: What Fun!
text:
*Updated-See below

This Halloween inflatable is so much fun! It's a house (shoe?) with various Halloween characters. It inflates pretty quickly. It's tall, but it still has some width to it which helps it stay upright better. I have found that narrow inflatables are more likely to fall over in heavy winds, even if staked and secured. Rope and stakes are included. The LED lights inside work as expected.

*10/10/21 - I changed my rating from 5 to 3 stars. We went outside this morning and this was completely deflated. My husband did some trouble shooting. He removed the power supply and swapped it with one from another inflatable that did work. It immediately started powering up again. So the original power supply had failed. It's still a cute Halloween decoration, but it should last more than 1 week! It's still 2 weeks before Halloween!

title: Batteries Required
text: This witch is a hoot! She's animated and has a few phrases that she repeats. Her arms move as she talks. The eyes glow red when she's activated. Unfortunately, our witch is missing the LED light in one of her eyes, so she only has 1 glowing eye. I looked through the packaging in case it had fallen out, but to no avail. We have her hanging by the front door. Batteries are required and not included.

title: Weather Proof!
text: I really like this Halloween garden flag. The material is durable and weather proof. The colors are vibrant. It fit on my garden flag pole easily. It looks super cute!

title: Very Nice
text: This metal pumpkin decoration is very nice. It's smaller than I anticipated but that's on me for not reading the measurements. It has a little stand in the back which seems to be doing fine so far. I have it outside by my porch, but since it doesn't have any stakes, I wonder if it will fall over easily in windy weather. It looks great and is well made.

title: Unique Inflatable
text: This is definitely a unique Halloween inflatable. The size is good, though I wouldn't mind if it was even larger just so it would go better with the other inflatables we have. It inflates easily without any trouble. It comes with plastic stakes to tether it to the yard. I tried it out in the living room and was pleased with how it looks.

title: Some Assembly Required
text: Some assembly required! Yes, you do have to put this watering can together. The sprinkler head is not attached. It's easy to put it on, but I did wonder whether or not I was putting it on the right way for a moment. When you think about it though, there's no doubt what direction to put the head on! It holds a gallon of water. It's plastic, so it's not going to rust. I was actually impressed that even when tipping it over substantially, I had no water coming out of the top where you fill it. I have had other watering cans that as soon as you tip it so far, you can bet the water will start flowing out of the top.

title: Great Halloween Cat
text: We have a black cat. When we first adopted her, we called her a vampire cat because of her fangs. We saw this and had to have it. Yes, it's called a dragon cat, but it could just as easily be a vampire cat! That works for us! It inflates easily. The blower is not too noisy. The noise is comparable to other inflatables. The front feet are weighted with sand (or other material) whereas the back ones are not. It comes with rope and stakes to secure it in place. There are LED lights inside for fun effects. We have tried this out in the living room but can't wait until we set it up in the yard.

title: Very Cute
text: We have been putting up Halloween inflatables for the past 2 years. They're an easy and fun way to decorate. I liked this skeleton pup because it was unique and different from a lot of the other inflatables out there. It's long and short. I found those work well because the ones that are not very wide but very tall tend to get knocked over easily. This one comes with stakes and rope. I had a little difficulty inflating it until I discovered that it was unzipped. Usually they come zipped up and inflate right away, so I didn't look for that at first. He's very cute. We plan to put all the inflatables out next weekend at the start of October.

title: Gobble Gobble!
text: We've started putting out holiday inflatables at Halloween and Christmas. Now we can put this turkey out for Thanksgiving! He's large and wide. It didn't take long for him to fill up, but I did have to help a little by positioning the arms and tail feather a bit so the air could reach those areas. He has some LED lights inside. The noise the fan makes is comparable to other inflatables we've used. He has 4 plastic stakes and some rope. Last year we bought extra metal stakes because the plastic ones are really difficult to get into the ground here in Georgia. I should have some extras for him. He's very cute and I am excited to put him out this November.

title: Halloween Kitty
text: I love Halloween kitties (and regular kitties, too). I was excited to see an inflatable of a Halloween kitty, so when I did see it, I had to have it. It's easy to inflate. It comes with rope and plastic stakes to tether it to the ground. There's an LED light inside that makes it glow nicely. It's going to be a great addition to our outdoor Halloween display.

title: Awesome Halloween Inflatable!
text: This is an awesome Halloween inflatable! We have several different ones and this one is a really good quality. It has an external blower which none of the others have. It's mighty powerful, too. It's huge! I inflated in in the middle of the living room and it was immense! It inflates rather quickly. I did have to help a little by untwisting some of the portions to allow air flow. I think I counted 8 sturdy loops attached to the unit where you fasten to the metal stakes. There's also some thin rope, too. From my experience with inflatables, I think this one is going to be stable and secure once it's tethered and assembled. I am very impressed with this one!

title: So Far It's Durable
text: We have gone through at least 2 flags so far this year. We keep our flag out all the time. We have a light shining on it at night. The others have all ripped, frayed, and had faded. My husband, being a former Boy Scout and Boy Scout leader, is particular about his flags and doesn't like to display them if they're in poor condition. This one looks good and so far it's durable. I wanted a fresh one in honor of 9/11 and this looks very nice out there. The stars are embroidered. The stripes seem to be securely stitched. Only time will tell!
