I hope we get at least a few good months with it. Our old flag is waiting to be taken to the Boy Scouts so it can be properly retired.

title: Halloween Fun!
text: Over the last few years, we've started accumulating outdoor inflatables for Halloween decorating. Our house is definitely the most decorated one during the month of October. What I really like about this one, is the shape. It's wide and short. We've had some troubles with the tall skinny ones in the past. They tend to get knocked over during strong winds, even when staked to the ground. Of course, only time will tell with this one. But since it's lower to the ground, I don't see that becoming a problem. It inflates easily. I set it up in the house and it is very wide! The noise it makes (the fan) is comparable to other inflatables. There are some LED lights inside. It only comes with 2 stakes, so hopefully that will be enough. The stakes are plastic, which is often more difficult to get into the ground. We have purchased extra metal ones just for our inflatables to make it easier.  It also comes with some rope. Now I must show some restraint and wait until closer to October before setting it up.

title: Beautiful!
text: I am so pleased and happy with this waterfall fountain. It's a large size. It comes mostly assembled. We did have to position the light and the pump into the basin before filling with water. We have this out on the patio below the deck. It works well and does a great job of creating a peaceful and serene environment.

title: Cute Garden Decor
text: This resin cat is really cute! It's perfect for the garden. The size is good. It looks nice in my flower bed. The details are fun!

title: Sturdy
text: We just started feeding the birds again after a break for the summer after hearing about all the strange bird illnesses. When we took our feeders down, we threw out some of the ones that hadn't fared well over the years. This one seems pretty sturdy. It's easy to fill. I like that there are 4 perches on it so we can have multiple diners at a time. We clean our feeders with a 1 part bleach to 9 parts water solution every 2 weeks as recommended by the National Wildlife Health Center

title: Large Bag
text: We get a lot of finches visiting our yard. I used to buy prefilled finch socks, but I've started using refillable ones recently. I found it was easier to fill my finch sock by scooping up the seed in a plastic tumbler, then transferring it to the sock. The majority of it stayed in the sock with there being minimal escaping. It seems to be attracting the finches!

title: Fun Halloween Decor
text: We go all out for Halloween. Our house is THAT house that has multiple inflatables, ghosts, ghouls, headstones and more for the month of October. This witch will make a great addition to our yard decor. The witch is easy to arrange into position. The quality of the materials is good. We are very pleased with her.

title: Small
text: This hollow tree trunk is much smaller than I expected. I didn't read the measurements at all, but I went by the recommended creatures.  My daughter has a leopard gecko and a milk snake. I don't think her leopard gecko would fit in it at all. The snake could slither through it because he's pretty narrow, but I'm not sure he could coil up underneath it. The piece seems to be a decent quality and it looks nice. The creatures could easily climb on it, but as far as hiding in it, that would be unlikely.

title: Finch Sock
text: We get lots of finches at our house, so we started using finch socks a couple of years ago. I had been buying prefilled ones that you dispose of when you're done. I like that these are reusable. Plus, I have found it to be cheaper to fill your own. I use thistle seeds for these socks. A little of the seed comes out, but that's the same thing with the prefilled ones. They are easy to wash. The actual socks are a little thicker and sturdier than the prefilled ones are. I am satisfied with these.

title: Comfy!
text: This gravity chair comes fully assembled out of the box. It's very sturdy and accommodates my husband without any difficulties. It's very comfy, too. It folds up for easy storage.

title: Vibrant!
text: I've had a similar garden flag in my front garden for the past year. It had gotten very faded and was in desperate need of a refresh. This one is very vibrant. The material is burlap and the description says it's fade resistant. Of course, only time will tell. In the meanwhile, it looks great and I like showing my support to my friends and neighbors.

title: Fits Well
text: This grill cover fits are grill well. It's sturdy and doesn't feel cheap. It can be tightened to keep it in place. I am pleased with it.

title: I have lots of sprouts!
text: This is my second hydroponic system. My first one was a different style. I started getting sprouts, but they didn't survive. After about two months without any success, I got rid of it. I was very disappointed. I was looking forward to having fresh herbs! I saw this and it was a different design. It looked more like the aerogarden that my friend has and she has had a lot of success with hers. Set up was easy. The directions were clear. It comes with everything except the seeds. It even comes with the plant food.  Within a week, I had several sprouts. My plants are growing nicely. I am thrilled with it. I'm growing arugula, basil, oregano, chives, and cilantro.

title: Seems to be working
text: Every summer we have to deal with mosquitoes. I've been hesitant to use chemicals because we have so much wildlife in our backyard. This seems to be working. It's collecting small, winged insects. I can identify a couple of them as moths, but the rest are mostly likely mosquitoes, gnats, or no-see-ums. I'm more than happy to get rid of those as well. Set up was easy. We did have the lid upside at first. We noticed that it wasn't staying open and figured out that was the issue. That was quickly remedied. For the first few days we did smell the attract stuff when we were near it, but I've either become accustomed to it now or it's not as noticeable. It's quiet and doesn't disturb us when we're outside. We have been using it for about 2 weeks now.

title: Cute!
text: I've been doing a lot of gardening this year. I have a nice assortment of herbs on my deck. Sometimes I'm really good about watering and other times, I'm not. These self watering globes are helpful for those times when I'm not good about it. The globes came packaged in styrofoam that was taped shut. It was a little difficult getting it opened and in doing so, two of the globes fell onto the floor. The neck (or tip?) of one of them broke off. I really only needed 4 of these, so it wasn't the end of the world, but still, I wasn't thrilled that one of them broke. The globes are really cute. I like the bright colors that they come in. It seems easy enough to work. This will be especially helpful when I go out of town.

title: Minimal Assembly Required
text: This rain gauge is so cute! Minimal assembly is required. There's a solar powered LED light that lights up the bottom of the rain gauge. We have this on the deck. We stuck in it a large flower pot where we're growing catnip for the kitties. I like that it's decorative not just functional.

title: Well Made
text: We've been feeding all the birds in the neighborhood or so it seems. We get a few woodpeckers and some other birds that like suet. I was excited to be able to have multiple suet stations since this is 2 sided. It's well made and is working well. We put the suet up and it has been quite popular. The suet is almost gone after just a few days. We don't plan to hang it back up for a while though, because of the bird sicknesses that are going around in our part of the country. Once the bird sicknesses are under control, we'll put back all of our bird feeders, but not before thoroughly cleaning them out.

title: Bird Approved
text: This birdseed has been bird approved by the birds in my neighborhood. The bag is a little small for the price. I personally would expect to get  much larger bag at that price. The bag filled one and half of my feeders before it was empty.  The food seems to be decent. It's nearly all gone!

title: Soothing Low Tones
text: This wind chime is lovely! It creates soothing low tones which are very nice to hear. The wind chime came wrapped well. The overall quality is good. This would make a nice gift.

title: Fun to Watch
text: This bird feeder is fun to watch. The feeder is sturdy. The suction cups seem to be strong enough. They've held up the feeder for a few days now without any trouble. There's not a lot of room for birdseed, so it has to be refilled frequently. I guess it would be much heavier and risk falling if it did hold more food. Overall, it's amusing.

title: Sprouting!
text: I have been waiting to write my review until my seeds were sprouting. Yesterday, I saw a few sprouts! The seeds seem to be thriving. It will still take a while before I'm able to use my herb garden so I can't comment on the quality of the end product. I am excited to have heirloom herbs though.

title: Easy to Assemble
text: My husband was busy when this arrived, so I put it together myself. If I say something is easy to assemble, than I mean it! I don't like reading instructions. I don't have an engineering type of mind and I get easily frustrated when trying to put things together. This was super easy! I had no difficulties at all. Well, except about half way through I realized that I was putting the nuts on upside down, but it wasn't difficult to fix. The finished plant stand is sturdy and looks great! It can easily accommodate lots of plants. I am very pleased with how this turned out!

title: Nice Quality
text: These 5x8 inch American flags are the perfect size for putting in the front flower bed. They're a nice quality. None of them broke when sticking them into the dirt for the holiday weekend.

title: Just What I Needed
text: I've been needing a watering can with a narrow, thin spout. This is just what I needed! I have a hydroponic planter with a small opening. I keep making a mess when watering. Now with this skinny spout, I am not spilling water everywhere. The watering can is sturdy and does the job! Plus, I love the pink color!

title: So Easy!
text: You got to love it when furniture doesn't require any assembly! This is so easy. You literally take it out of the box and open it up. There are some white/clear plastic pieces on the chairs that I wasn't sure about. I started to remove them (which isn't easy) thinking that they were just there for transport. My husband stopped me after the first one was removed and decided that they are integral to the design. We put it back on. When looking at the pictures on the listing, they're visible. They're not white, but they're not transparent either. They're definitely noticeable. Other than that, this is a great set. My daughter is moving into off campus housing in a couple of months and this will be used on her patio. The red color is vibrant. The pieces are surprisingly sturdy. I am a plus size mom and I felt safe sitting on the chairs. My daughter is excited to have these!

title: Convenient
text: I've seen one hummingbird at our house this spring, but I haven't seen any at the bird feeder yet. I like the convenience of this food. I poured about half of it into the feeder. I usually add more, but since I haven't seen any activity at the feeder yet, I wanted to be conservative. Plus, I always wash out the feeder about every 2 weeks so I will have enough for another filling. This isn't too expensive, but it does cost a little more than the bottles of prepared food that I buy at the store and I get several more fillings out of that. It's also easier than making my own simple syrup.

title: Helpful When Out of Town
text: This watering system is helpful when you're out of town. My husband & I recently traveled out of state. Our college student son lives at home with us, so he was in charge of the pets and plants while we were gone. It's a lot to ask someone to care for the plants. So I set these up to do the job for him. It's not that he would completely ignore them, but he just wouldn't check on them as much as I do. I am happy to say that these worked well and none of my plants died. I'm not crazy about the way these look with the bottles. I think I would prefer it if this came with nice looking bottles for the task. The rope does a good job of transporting the water. I'm not using these regularly, but when I have to go out of town, I will definitely rely on them.

title: Great Lights!
text: I've turned my bakers rack into a plant shelf. It doesn't get direct sunlight, so I wanted some plant lights to help out. These lights are great! We zip tied them to the bottom of the top wire shelf. The lights offer plenty of light to my needed plants. I like that these are a white light. I had another one that was red/blue and I found it difficult to see how the plants were doing. This makes it much easier to see them.

title: It's Sprouting!
text: I knew nothing about hydroponics until I recently was checking on a friend's house while she was going. She has the name brand aerogarden and my job was to check the water and add more if needed. Her plants were full grown and looked beautiful! I immediately turned green with plant envy! When I saw this, I was excited to give it a try. The directions are a bit weak. I *think* I set up everything fine. I followed the directions to the best of my ability. It comes with the pods, but no seeds. I picked up some seeds from the store and soaked them as instructed. I planted basil, oregano, chives, and cilantro. It's been about 2 weeks now and I have basil and oregano sprouting. It's actually a little more than sprouting because I can see tiny leaves. The water is not very easy to see so it's difficult to know when you need to add water. I ordered some plant food for hydroponic gardens because none was included. The light works, but the timer feature seems irregular or inconsistent. I really hope this works well. I will definitely update my review later.

title: Excellent Umbrella!
text: My husband and I enjoy sitting out on the deck during the early evenings. When the sun sets, it hits us right in the eyes. Our old umbrella was in need of replacing, so this one was ordered. I love the chestnut color. It's natural looking. The fabric has a woven type look that does allow a little bit of light through, but it does block the super bright sunlight. It fit into our patio table as expected. It didn't take very long to set it up. The crank and tilt features work nicely. Overall, we are very pleased with this.

title: Great Size!
text: My daughter has a bunch of succulent plants but we're not very good about keeping good care of them. I got some other self watering planters recently that I really liked, so I thought I would transfer some of her succulents into these. These planters are a great size! Once planted/assembled, they do a good job of keeping the soil damp. Since I have used other similar pots, I can say that these are not quite as easy to see how much water is left. With these you have to actually lift the top part out and look inside to see how much water is left. The others I have, are clear at the bottom so you can see right away how much water is in it. Plus, it has a little side opening that you can pour more water into when it's needed. This one you have to lift the top first before adding more water.

title: Seems to Be Working!
text: I've had this set up for over a week now. I'm happy to say that it seems to be working just fine. I was skeptical about the process. I didn't realize that it takes the water of the air and stores it. But after 9 days, the soil is nicely damp and I have not watered it since the initial transplanting of it. It does hum a bit which is a little annoying, but tolerable. I'm not really good with plants, but with something like this, it makes it easy and fool proof!

title: Just What I Needed
text: I recently got some self watering planters. They have a small side cut out for you to add more water. I needed a narrow watering can or other implement in order to get the water into the base of the planter. This watering can works perfectly and is just what I needed. It has an interesting design. You can't see how the water gets into the long skinny spout. I guess it doesn't matter because it does the job! The fact that the watering can is pink is a bonus! The spray bottle matches and is great for light misting.

title: Easy to Use
text: I am just loving these self watering planters! They are easy to use and they work well! I am using them for some herbs on my deck. It's easy to see when water needs to be added. My plants are thriving like never before. I am usually one who forgets to water them so this is awesome!

title: Works Well!
text: I wasn't sure what I was getting into when I ordered this. But after about a week, I'm pleased to say that it works well. I really like that the light is on a timer and comes on as scheduled. I am using it for a bunch of succulents that we have. I recently replanted one and that's the one that I keep on this gadget. I positioned the light so it gets the planters on both sides of it as well. The platform of the unit is not level, so I had to add some wooden craft sticks to help keep my planter level. The string that's provided for the self watering isn't very long which effected the size of container that I used. Overall, I am pleased with this! It makes plant keeping simple!

title: Arrived Broken
text: I was super excited to give this squirrel feeder a try. The squirrels are always stealing food from the bird feeders so I thought it would be nice for them to have their own feeder. Plus, we all can use a laugh at their expense. The feeder arrived broken. One of the ears was broken off. My husband was able to glue it back on though there were a few tiny pieces that were missing but they didn't impact the finished head. I was disappointed that there was no rope or string included for hanging it nor were there any instructions on how to do so. We concocted something and we filled it with peanuts. The food is gone from it, but we never saw anyone eating from it. We even had a camera positioned on it for a few days. Overall, I was disappointed with this.

title: Great for GeoCaching!
text: My family likes to use fake rocks like this for GeoCaching! This fake rock is pretty good. It has some heft to it and feels like a real rock. I've had others that were so light weight that you knew it was fake right away. The plastic bottom piece is easy to remove and replace. I don't think this would be completely waterproof. I didn't try it out, but it seems like water could get in to it. We will put our GeoCache items in a baggy or something to keep it dry. Overall, this is a good fake rock.

title: Fun Variety of Garden Flags
text: I just started keeping a garden flag by the front porch. This is a fun variety of flags that will keep you set for the whole year! The flags are a good quality. The designs are colorful. I appreciate that it includes a clip to keep the flag steady.

title: Nice Hooks!
text: These shepherd hooks are a nice bronze color. They come in pieces, but each set was packaged separately so you don't mix up the pieces. Assembly wasn't difficult, but there were a couple of pieces that didn't thread easily and required a firmer hand to do so. The finished hooks are nice and look great! I have some solar lanterns hanging on them.

title: Solid Feel to It
text: We've stopped using plastic garden spray nozzles because they keep breaking on us. Before this arrived, we had one metal one. We have hoses in the front yard and the back. Of course, the nozzle was never where we needed it! The addition of this one will make things easier because there is one with each hose now. It has a solid feel to it. It seems to be pretty sturdy. There are several spray options to choose from. I just used this to clean out the bird feeders and it was more than powerful enough to get all the seed that was stuck deep inside the long tube shaped feeder. Time will tell how it holds up, but for now we're satisfied.

title: Misleading Pictures
text: The quality of this shepherd's hook is good. It requires some assembly by screwing the pieces together. It's sturdy and strong. I did feel that the pictures were misleading. Most of the pictures featured 2 hooks. After mine arrived, I did go back and reread the description and it mentions  a single hook.

title: Cute Designs!
text: I have 4 throw pillows in my living room that I use for seasonal decorating. I have some spring Easter ones, but once Easter is over, I don't want bunnies and eggs in my living room. Instead, this year we'll have lovely birds. The pictures are beautiful and colorful. The quality of the pillow covers is comparable to the others that I have already. They fit my pillows fine. The zippers work as expected. I am very happy with these and can't wait to use them.

title: Love!
text: This little bird feeder is just what I wanted! As spring is approaching, I want to start putting out small amounts of fresh fruits to attract some new birds. This little dish will work perfectly! I am super excited about how easy it is to clean! My daughter is taking an infectious disease class for her wildlife biology degree. She's been lecturing us on the importance of cleaning bird feeders regularly. Some bird feeders are very difficult to clean, but this one is not. The bowl of this feeder isn't very deep, so you are limited to what you can put in it. The hanger is sturdy. I just love this!

title: Great Quality
text: This American flag is a great quality. The stripes are sewn together. Stitching looks good. The stars are embroidered. The colors are vibrant. We have this outside our garage where a light shines on it during the night. I am proud to have such a nice looking flag outside my home.

title: Great Bird Seed!
text: Valley Farms makes great bird seed. I have been very satisfied with the varieties that I have used. My husband and I keep several different bird feeders stocked for the birds. We get cardinals all year long. The mix of seeds looks great. I personally couldn't tell you what seeds various birds like, but I trust the experts to know. The birds (not just the cardinals) seem to be very happy with this seed.

title: Great Quality!
text: My husband and I started hanging up bird feeders a couple of years ago. We're still new to all things birds. We didn't even know that some birds ate peanuts! These peanuts appear to be a great quality. They look appetizing, at least to us! After we filled one of the feeders with these, it was at least a couple of days before we saw any activity. Since then, we've noticed the amount of food has gone down a few inches. It's much slower than our regular bird seeds. I thought we might see squirrels eating from it, but they have been skipping that one and going to the seed cakes which are further from the tree.

title: Quality Bird Seed
text: This is a good quality bird seed. The size of the bag allowed me to fill one large, long tube shaped feeder with no leftovers. I've seen several birds eating from it throughout the days.

title: Sturdy
text: We ordered this in an effort to distract the squirrels from our bird feeders. The feeder is sturdy and seems to be well made. There is a small opening at the bottom of the acrylic side to allow food to fall through. The opening is small and would not work on larger pieces of food. We have put loose feed corn in it and that fits through the opening fine. We have yet to see any squirrels eating at it, but the food level has decreased some.

title: Good Bird Seed
text: These bird seed is solely sunflower seeds. I usually buy mixed birdseed but every now and then I will purchase a bag of just sunflower seeds because it does seem to be popular with the birds. This is a large bag and should last a while. I have seen many birds enjoying it, so I am glad that I got it. The seed seems to be a good quality. I've noticed minimal dust or scraps.

title: Works with Sunlight
text: We just got our first birdbath. I've been a little concerned about possible mosquito breeding in the warmer months. I've read that moving water can help prevent that. Thus, a fountain for the birdbath. This fountain requires sunlight to operate. The first few days that we had it, the fountain produced a very small spray and sometimes no spray at all. Those days were very gloomy and grey. Then we had a very sunny day and the fountain sprayed a stream that was at least a foot high. There is no battery on the unit so it only operates during the daytime. Set up was easy.

title: Excellent Quality
text: My husband has been wanting to put up a bee house, so I was excited to order this one. He's a pretty picky guy when it comes to things and does a lot of DYI himself. He was very impressed with the quality and craftsmanship of this bee home. There's an overhang to protect the tubes. The tubes are tightly lodge inside, but are still easy to remove. From what we've read, we need to hang it outside in March, so that gives us a little bit of time to finish researching where the best place/direction is to locate this. This did come with an informative sheet about the bee homes and the mason bees which as been helpful.

title: Birds Seem to Like It
text: We have one of those suet cages and we keep it stocked with suet all year long. These suet blocks fit in the cage well. They seem comparable to other ones that we have gotten. The birds seem to like it as I've seen multiple birds eating from it daily.

title: Popular with the Birds!
text: I've always wanted a bird bath, but the heavy cement ones are so expensive! This one is much more affordable and light weight too. It has a copper patina look to it but it's made out of resin. You do have to assemble it. It started out fine, but I had difficulties with one of the post pieces screwing into the base. It was like the threading was off. My husband was able to get it aligned and screwed together properly. Once it's assembled, it was taller than I expected. It looks to be about the size of the standard cement ones. I was afraid it would be much smaller, so I was pleased. We didn't see the stakes in the box, so my husband cut some wire and bent it into a stake shape. You definitely need to stake it down or I'm sure that a strong gust of wind would tip it over. Later, when we were getting our cardboard recycling ready, we came across the stakes, but they had gotten tucked under one of the box flaps. Now that our bird bath is up and running, we've seen many birds visit it. I haven't seen any bathers, but I imagine it's too cold for that. I've seen birds perching on the edges and sipping. My husband wasn't thrilled when it arrived, not knowing what to expect, but it's exceeded our expectations.

title: Nice Quality
text: My husband has read about making homes for bees and was interested in doing so. I ordered these tubes for him. They were exactly what he had been wanting. We don't have a frame/house for it yet, but my husband has downloaded some plans to build them. From our research, we want to have the house ready in March, so we still have a couple of months. The quality of these tubes is very nice. They are sturdy for what they are. I'll have to come back later and update this after the bees have hopefully made their home.

title: Very Little Breakage
text: A few years ago, my husband and I started putting out an assortment of bird feeders. Now at least once a week, I'm out there refilling and replacing. We have a larger rectangle seed  cake cage that we use. This seed cake is about half of the size of the cage, but it worked. I've seen many birds eating from it since I put it out. The seed cake  arrived with minimal breakage. I like seed cakes because they're easier to fill than traditional fill up type bird feeders. Though we do have one of those, we have the rectangle cage, a suet cage and a hanger for donut/tube seed cakes. This one has been outside for a couple of days and it still has at least half of it left.

title: Great for Window Sill
text: These planters are very cute. They are great for window sills. They're pretty shallow and didn't work for my intended purpose. I wanted to transplant some of my succulents. However, is we get any offsets, this would be useable. There are 2 planters in this set and they each come with a bamboo tray. They have a simple and clean design to them.

title: Accurate Testing
text: Our hot tub uses bromine. We test the water at least a couple of times a week, sometimes more. We go through a lot of test strips. I compared these strips with the ones we already had. They are slightly wider than the others. The test results were identical, except that these also have a chlorine indicator and we don't use chlorine. I really like of the 100 test strips included, only 50 are ready to go right away. The remaining 50 are sealed so they won't be exposed to air or other things prematurely and become ineffective. These arrived at a good time as we are almost out of our other bottle of test strips.

title: Love the Message!
text: For several months I've had a corrugated sign with this same message on it in my flower bed, but it was beginning to look a bit sad. This garden flag looks nice. The printing is vibrant. It fits on my garden flag stand well. I love the message!!

title: Great Inflatable!
text: I love this Christmas inflatable! It works very well. It came with lots of rope and stakes to secure it down. The rope is white and does seem to stick out more than the black rope does that our other inflatables have. The tree doesn't stand up straight. I think it would have been better to have the tree without the trunk and it would be more stable. I remember when I was a kid, I often drew Christmas trees directly on the snow without any kind of trunk and it was fine. It's not terrible, it's just that when you have the ropes tied, it's very difficult to get it to stand straight up. It was either tilting slightly left or slightly right. The Santa and mailbox stand up fine. There are LED lights inside the unit and some of them flash/twinkle which is a nice effect. We've had a few very windy days and some rain since we set this up in the front yard and it hasn't had any problems at all.

title: Nice Flag!
text:
Updated 2/5/2021: I changed my rating from 5 stars to 3 stars. We've had the flag out for 2 months now. It is beginning to fray and some of the stripes are now beginning to show signs of separating. The flag is still in tact as I write this update, but it's not performing as we had hoped. We leave the flag out 24 hours a day with a light shining on during the dark hours. We have had some very windy days and at least one of those days, we did take it down until the wind subsided. The flag has show no signs of fading.

Original Post: We needed to replace our flag that we keep on our house. The color had faded significantly and it had small tears that were beginning to become noticeable. This one is well made. The stars are nicely embroidered. There's also stitching between each stripe. It's vibrantly colored and looks great! We will be dropping our old flag off at the American Legion near our house where the Boy Scouts collect them and then have an official flag retiring ceremony.

title: Solid Bracket
text: We have a flag pole mounted on the front of the house, but there's no light near it. We have been using solar slights pointed at it, but it doesn't provide as much illumination as the flag deserves. My husband wanted to move it to a spot on the garage under a house light. He decided it would easier to mount a new bracket rather than taking the other one down because it's mounted onto brick. This one is a solid and sturdy bracket. It is not adjustable, but it does have 2 different positions that you can use. Installation was straight forward and hardware was provided.

title: Great Sign!
text: This is a great sign! The quality is very good. It's a corrugated plastic material. The text is clear and easy to read. My daughter lives in a dorm and hung this up in her window. She is very proud to have it.

title: Huge Santa!
text: This Santa is huge! It's definitely 10 feet tall as described. It takes a long time (several minutes) to fully inflate. That's a lot longer than most inflatables that we own. I'm wondering if the fan/motor is not very powerful in this guy. Once inflated, he looks great! It comes with some thin rope and 2 metal stakes. I am concerned with that not being enough to hold him securely in place. Most inflatables that we have, have more than just 2 stakes. Most have loops at the base for stakes in addition to the side ropes that you stake down. I tested it out in the living room, but when we put him outside after Thanksgiving, I'm going to suggest to my husband that he finds some additional way of securing him down. There are some LED lights inside. This is really a good looking Santa!

title: Nice Flag Pole
text: I didn't know flag poles like this even existed until my husband mentioned that we should replace our old one with this type. We were getting frustrated because we were having to unwrap our flag from it's previous pole almost daily because the wind. This keeps the flag from doing that. Yay! We had a little trouble putting this together. The pieces have to go in a certain order which we didn't realize. The sizes of the pieces must be slightly different. The first time my husband put it together, we couldn't get the cap on it. It wouldn't thread on to the pole. At first he thought it was a faulty piece. But then we took it apart. I started trying the cap on different pieces and found one that it screwed onto perfectly. Then we had to figure out which one was next and so on. It wasn't difficult, it just took a little longer than expected. For something that should have taken a minute or two, we spent closer to 10 or 15 minutes. It's very sturdy and solid feeling. It's been up for nearly a week and we haven't had to unwrap the flag at all!

title: As Described
text: We have an assortment of small succulent plants. I haven't really done much for them besides watering and giving them light. When I saw this, I thought it would be beneficial to use this soil that is specifically geared toward the nutrition of succulents. It's a good size bag and has probably double the amount of dirt that I needed for my plants. It's pretty much as described.  My plants have been replanted with this soil and all seem to be thriving. I am pleased.

title: Cute Outdoor Garden Flag
text: This is a cute, outdoor garden flag for Halloween. It's well made. The printing is good. The colors are vibrant. It's an easy way to add some holiday decoration to your yard.

title: Heavy Duty!
text: We moved into our current house about 7 years ago. Our old house had a flag pole holder out front and we kept a flag out all the time. (Yes, we kept a light on it as the guidelines for the American flag state.) My husband recently mentioned that we should get one on the new house. So here it is! It's very heavy duty and much stronger than the one we had on the old house. Our house front is brick, so my husband had to get different screws to install it, but that wasn't a problem. I like that you can adjust the angle of it. We're happy that we can display our flag again!

title: Love the Statement!
text: I love the statement of this sign. It covers a lot of issues that are going on in our world. It's not preachy, but lets people know where you stand on these issues. The sign is made from sturdy corrugated plastic. It's smaller than the usual yard signs. I have mine near the house in the flower bed.  I am proud to have this at my house.

title: Very Sturdy!
text: This nozzle is wonderful! It's very sturdy and heavy duty. It's metal and not plastic.  It has 6 different spray options. It works as expected.

title: Sweet Reindeer Inflatable!
text: Last December, my family purchased a couple of holiday inflatables at the local hardware chain. We were really pleased with how easy they are to use. I saw this and wanted to add it to our collection. This is a sweet reindeer. I set it up in the living room to try it out. It's not particularly big when compared to other inflatables, but it's not miniscule either. Set up is very easy. There are weights in the bottom to help keep it upright. And you definitely want to stake it into the ground (stakes included). There are some LED lights inside. Overall, a cute holiday decoration!

title: Great Halloween Decor!
text: We love decorating the yard and house for Halloween. This giant spider and web is awesome! First we had to figure out a place that would work to hang it. We ended up hanging it from a tree. Then my husband tied and staked down a piece of rope. Then he attached the web to the  tree using 3 points of contact and the rope for 2 more points. He staked another 2 points of contact into the ground. It looks great! The giant spider's legs hook onto the web. You can bend them as desired. We did install batteries (not included) but have been keeping it turned off for the time being. The set also comes with the smaller stretchy spider web for additional decorating.

title: It's Huge!
text: This Halloween inflatable is huge! I inflated it in my living room to try it out and it completely blocked the entry to the room. My kitties were very concerned about it!  I'm very excited to put this out in October! It doesn't take too long to fully inflate. Stakes & rope are included which you will definitely want to use because of the size. The noise it makes is comparable to other inflatables. I don't doubt that it's 8 feet tall. It's also pretty wide. It will make a great center piece to our Halloween display this year!

title: Halloween Fun!
text: I am so excited to have some Halloween inflatables this year. I can't wait to decorate my yard with them. This Grim Reaper is huge! It's definitely 8 feet tall (or at least very close). I tried it out in my living room and it reached the doorway. It was easy to set up - just plug it in and wait. I did find that I had to help a little by straightening out the body to allow the air to reach all the parts. I haven't had to do this with my other inflatables, so I am guessing that it's because it's so tall. My other ones are 6 feet or less. When putting it outside, I will definitely utilize the tethers and stakes that are included to keep it secured. As far as the noise it makes, it is comparable to my other holiday inflatables. There are lights inside - red eyes and a few white spots. Overall, I am pleased with this and am looking forward to setting him outside in the yard at the beginning of October.

title: Easy to Set Up!
text:
My family loves to decorate for Halloween. Holiday inflatables are an easy way to add some festive decorations. We got our first inflatables this past Christmas and now we're hooked! This ghost is about 5 feet tall. I'm 5'6" and he comes to about my mouth or nose. He has an LED light inside that rotates assorted colors. The light colors aren't particularly Halloween colors, but it's fun nonetheless. This guy is easy to set up and includes rope and stakes to tether him down. I'm looking forward to setting up my Halloween decorations next month!

Updated 10/15/20: My original review was 5 stars, but after 3 weeks, the motor on this inflatable died. The LED lights still work, but without the fan, it won't inflate. We have another one from the same brand and the same thing happened a day or two ago. Very disappointed that it didn't last through Halloween.

title: Fun for Halloween!
text:
My husband and I have always gone all out when it comes to decorating at Halloween time. This year we've added some holiday inflatables to the mix. This one is 5 feet tall and fully inflates in about a minute. There are LED lights inside to light up the ghost and eyes on the Jack O'Lantern. There are loops on the sides so you can tie them down. The rope and stakes are included. It even comes with a storage bag. It works well and will add to our Halloween fun this year!

Updated 10/15/20: My original review was 5 stars, but I have reduced it to 2. We set it up the last week of September. Three weeks later, the fan diet. The LED lights still work, but without the fan, it won't inflate. We have another one from the same brand and it died on us a couple of days ago. Very disappointed that it didn't last through Halloween.

title: Awesome Inflatable!
text: This Day of the Dead/Halloween inflatable is awesome! I absolutely love it! It's super easy to put up - basically just plug it in and it auto inflates. There are LED lights inside. It comes with plastic stakes to secure it to the ground. I tried it out in my living room. The groom is taller than I am with his hat. I'm 5'6", so I would say it is close to 6 feet, if not 6 feet even. The details on the couple are great. I can't wait for the month of October so I can put these out in the yard!

title: Easy to Fill
text: We have returning humming birds every year. They usually stay for several months. We've been keeping one feeder out there for them, but we have seen some bullying among them. With 2 feeders, everyone should be able to eat without interference. This feeder is very easy to fill. Our other one is a traditional style glass one, but it has to be flipped over to hang it and it's always messy! This one is virtually mess-free! The lid doesn't seem to be very functional and more for decoration. The little perches are a nice feature. The pineapple design is very attractive. It's really a beautiful feeder!

title: Easy to Set Up
text: This inflatable dragon is easy to set up. Since it's still a few months until Halloween, we inflated him in the living room. It's pretty comparable to other inflatables that we have bought at the local stores. This comes with a few ground stakes so you can tether him to the ground. It makes no more or no less noise than other inflatables.  The lights inside worked fine. It says he's 6 feet tall, but that's stretching it. My husband is 6'2" and he is more than just 2 inches shorter than my husband. If you count the tip of his ears, maybe it's pretty close. This will be a great addition to our outdoor Halloween decorations!

title: Patriotic
text: This is a cute, patriotic garland. It's got a rustic vibe with the jute and burlap. There's glitter on the stars which I am not a fan of and in my opinion, it conflicts with the rustic look. I would rather there be no glitter at all. The quality of the garland is fine. The whole stretches across my mantle which is where I will hang it. I will need to adjust the hanging loops a little to get it to hang just right, as right now when it hangs, it droops too much. Overall, it's a good patriotic decor item and will make a nice addition to my July decorating.

title: Great Addition to My Patio
text: I love this bright colored, kitty garden flag. It's a great addition to my patio area. It's lightweight. It fits well on a standard garden flag stake. The colors are vibrant and it's a good print job. I love it!

title: Nice Flag Set
text: This flag set is almost identical to another one that I purchased recently. The stand is easy to assemble. There's a clip to attach to one side of the flag, though the other side is free. The flag itself is decent. The unit is sturdy and has done well in the crazy spring weather that we have right now.

title: Great for Birds!
text: My husband and I started keeping a bunch of bird feeders out in our backyard about a year ago. We were having to fill some of the feeders more than once a week. We started using the smaller stacks a few months ago and have been so happy with it. There is a lot less wasted bird seed now. The squirrels were a lot of the problem, but the birds would also cause some of the spillage. With the stacks/cakes, we've seen almost no bird seed on the ground below. It also seems to last longer. While the stacks/cakes cost a little more, we're saving money because we're not having to refill the feeders as much. The stacks seem to last at least a couple of weeks. This larger one had a little breakage upon opening. I'm estimating about 5% of it was loose in the package. We saved that and put that out for the squirrels. We did have to buy a special wire hanger for this. It has a nice mixture of seeds and nuts. It's been popular with the birds!

title: Nice Variety
text: Let me start by saying that I have not planted these yet, so I cannot comment on the quality of seeds that they are and anything about the germination. I have opened the package though, and I was impressed with what I saw. It's full of just seeds! There is nothing else in there. I really expected it to be mixed with some kind of filler, but it's not. There is a little booklet inside. Removing it was a little messy because seeds were stuck inside it and they fell out as I removed the booklet from the package. It has a list of all the different varieties of flowers as well as instructions for planting. It's still winter, so I can't plant these for at least another month. I will update my review if I am not satisfied with their growth.

title: Cute Lawn Decor
text: We're cat family and are excited to have some cute cat themed lawn decor. These are sturdy, metal garden stakes. Some assembly is required - screwing the stakes into the cat piece. They are large enough to be visible in the flower beds when the flowers are in bloom.

title: Popular with the Birds!
text: My husband and I are THAT couple that puts out multiple bird feeders. We enjoy watching the birds gather and eat. We even have binoculars to aid in our bird viewing. It's winter right now, and we're still going out there about once a week to refill the feeders. I didn't have anything to hang these food stacks with, so I ordered an inexpensive holder for them. Right now I have a stack of 3 hanging and it's been very popular with the birds. I don't know if it's just because it's something new and different, but every time I look, there are at least 2 or 3 birds on the stack. I started to open them in the kitchen and quickly stopped because of loose pieces. The stacks are pretty well contained, but when removing the plastic wrap, some seeds fell out. So far, the squirrels haven't found a way to get to it, but I'm expecting them to figure a way.

title: Very Nice!
text: I have an outdoor sofa and love seat on my patio outside. I have had a cover for the love seat, but not for the sofa. So for the past year, I've been stacking all the cushions for both pieces of furniture on the love seat and covering them with the one cover. This cover is very nice. It's a heavy material that doesn't look like it will tear easily with wind or other bad weather. It has a drawstring type feature so you can pull it tighter around the bottom so it doesn't blow off. The color and appearance is pretty neutral, which is good. It's nice not having to mess with all the cushions anymore!

title: Nice!
text: I've wanted a collapsible wagon for a while. I used to work with a couple of women who each owned a couple of them. They proved to be invaluable at times!! This one is a little different than their wagons. The first noticeable difference, is that you can pull or push this wagon because there are separate handles on each end. Another difference is that this one has the features on one of the pairs of wheels that allows the wagon to stand upright without having to lean against a surface. There was a small instruction sheet included with the wagon that said to attach the tape at the bottom of the wagon. There was no tape and we weren't really sure what it was talking about. We decided it was a translation issue and that they were referring to a velcro strap. The directions didn't say how to attach it and we really couldn't figure it out. We thought it might be an aid so you can pull on it in the center of the wagon to raise the inside of the wagon up so you can fold it. When we tried to do that, the strap always came undone. It could be folded or unfolded without that feature, so we weren't worried about it. My husband said he will put a large ziptie there and it should do the same job. Overall, the wagon is very sturdy and I would definitely call it heavy duty. I'm not sure how I lasted so long without one!

title: Sturdy!
text: Over the years, I have owned a few pop up tents. They're great for outdoor entertaining, tailgating, and more. This one is very sturdy. It's significantly a higher quality than the cheap $69 ones that they sell at the discount stores. The first one I had was one of those cheap ones and it didn't last very long. This one should last a few years without any problems. The frame feels heavy duty. The canvas is thick enough that it offers good protection. Set up and take down is as expected. Overall, it's a great tent!

title: Larger than Expected!
text: This plant light is larger than I expected and is probably overkill for the one little succulent plant that's using this light. It has four light bars that you can position to accommodate your needs. The timer feature is really nice. We were on vacation last week and we set it up so the light was on during the daytime hours. Overall, it's nice.

title: Beautiful!
text: This hummingbird feeder is beautiful! It seems to be pretty sturdy, but the hummingbirds have migrated for the winter and won't be around for a few more months to test it out. It looks nicer than the plastic one we were using last season. This has a perch and ant moat which are nice features. Again, until the hummingbirds return, I can't comment on how well those work. It comes with a hook to hang it. Although it's made from glass, it doesn't seem like it's going to break easily from normal use. It really is lovely!

title: Easy to Use!
text: This is such a great idea! It saves a lot of time and mess when it comes to feeding hummingbirds. I like the idea of the cartons because they can be cleaned out and recycled. They are decorated with bright flowers to attract the birds. There's a hanging piece attached to the top. The instructions are simple to follow. The hummingbirds have left for the season, but should be back in a few months. I'm excited to see how they like it.

title: A Juice Box for the Birds!
text: We have a few humming birds that return to our yard every year. They're usually here from about March through October. I'm really excited to use these next year when they return. The first year we made our own sugar water concoction, but that took a lot of work. The next year we had a bottle that we had to dilute with water. Then this past year we had a big bottle of pre-made nectar that was ready to go, but we had to refrigerate it the unused liquid so it took up valuable space in the refrigerator. This product is really the easiest out there! It's basically a juice box for the birds! (or birbs as I recently learned from my teenage daughter.) Even though it's not humming bird season, I did go ahead and try one out. I watched the seller's short video, but it really wasn't necessary because it's so simple!! It's not messy at all. The instructions suggest replacing once a week, which isn't terrible. The box is decorated in bright flowers to attract the birds.  I like that the packaging is recyclable. Because the hummingbirds have left for the season, I can't attest to whether or not the hummingbirds like this, but I like it!

title: Sturdy!!
text: A lot of the cheaper kitchen utensils flex too much that when removing items from the pan, you can't do it without messing up the appearance of the food. That's not usually a big deal, but I personally love it when my food looks good, too, and not just taste good! My kids have gotten used to my  ugly pancakes, but now there is hope! This turner doesn't flex or bend so it gets under the pancake the first time and lets you flip it without any trouble! It's dishwasher safe, too! I have become quite the fan of the Kitchen Aid utensils!

title: Stunning Detail
text: This statue is made of light weight resin. It looks like a heavier material. The front side is gorgeous. The detail is stunning. The backside is not as nice. At first, I wondered why there were slots on her back. Then my husband discovered the wings still in the styrofoam packing. The wings slide into the slots, but they don't fit well. It's a loose fit and they wobble a bit. Once in place, it's noticeable that it's not all one statue. I have this in my flower bed and it does look nice there.

title: Sturdy!
text: We're huge cat lovers and we also love birds. We set up our fist birdhouse a few weeks ago, and we've seen several different birds flying in and out to check it out. If that one birdhouse was so popular, I thought we might need another one. This is a bit scary looking. We mounted it to a tree in the back of the property. It's sturdy and it was easy to hang up. Our other birdhouse has a latched side entrance so the nest can be removed at the end of the season to allow a new tenant to reside. This does not. Any bird nests would be difficult to extract through the mouth.

title: Decent Brushes
text: Recently my son and I were looking for a basting brush in our kitchen drawers and came up empty handed. I know I've had some in the past, but I have no idea where they are. This comes with 3 brushes. They are basically the same, just different colors. The handles telescope which could be useful if using them at the grill, but most of my use will be indoors. The silicone brush head comes off so you can toss it in the dishwasher. My old basting brush had traditional brush bristles which would get oily and gross after lots of use. Even washing them didn't remove all the oiliness. The brush head holds thicker sauces well, but for more liquidy sauces (such as melted butter) it doesn't really hold much. It will move it around on the surface okay. I don't really need 3 brushes, so I'm using one and the others I have put in the boxes of kitchen stuff for my two college kids who are close to living on their own one day.

title: Understated
text: This garden rock looks better than I expected. It's understated and adds an interesting design element to my flower beds. The rock is pretty heavy and won't tip over in the various weather like some of my light weight resin garden decor does. The butterfly is made from iron and has a green, weathered look about it. I am very pleased with this item.

title: The Size of a Real Cat!
text: This is a light weight (resin material?) sculpture. It's about the size of a real cat. It looks like weathered bronze. The details of the cat are pretty good and it looks realistic. One of our cats passed away last year and is buried in the backyard. We decided to put this out there to mark the spot where he is buried.

title: Excellent!
text: I love this spatula! (or short turner if you prefer!). It is firmer than my others and doesn't flex at all. It is sturdy enough that you could use it to cut through and serve cake or lasagna. The handle is comfortable to grip. It's an excellent quality kitchen tool.

title: Slow Process
text: Repairing the yard has been a slow process with this seed/mulch combination, however, we are beginning to see some grass shoots. Bermuda grass spreads, so once we saw the shoots come up, we knew we were on the right track. It's been several weeks and required lots of watering. I would probably not want to do this if we had large bare patches, but with the small patches we had, I think it was okay. We started out with 2 patches that we wanted to work on. One was about the size of a standard car tire and the other was a little smaller. It's not a magical quick fix, but it does work.

title: Gorgeous!
text: This umbrella is gorgeous! I love that I get to see the pretty colorful design since the image is in the under side of the umbrella instead of the outer side. It's easy to open and close and does a good job of keeping me dry. It works better than regular umbrellas when getting in and out of the car. The handle is comfortable and easy to grip. I am very happy with it.

title: Seems to Work
text: My daughter has a bunch of little succulents on her bedroom window sill.  She's spotty with her watering and some of the plants do look as good as they did when we first bought them. So far, this plant food seems to be working. Overall, most of the plants are looking a little healthier since she first gave it to them. They seem to be perking up a bit. The food is easy to use. She's been following the directions on the bottle. My daughter said up a reminder on her phone so she can be better about watering/feeding them.

title: Works Great!
text: We grill out a lot at home. This makes grilling vegetables so much easier! It takes up about half of the grill space, but it still leaves plenty of room for grilling the meat for our family of four. It saves time, too. If we were grilling the veggies directly on the grill, it becomes time consuming to flip them all over. Here we just give it a shake or two which flips most of them. Or we can use a spatula easier because there are edges to help. It has changed colors a bit due to use, but that's pretty typical. Overall, we're happy with it.

title: Good Coverage!
text: This sprinkler is very light weight. It's easy to move around, but on the other side of the coin, it sometimes moves when you don't want it to. My husband has been placing a large rock on it to keep it in place. It does have good coverage and can reach the entire front yard. It's easy to use and set up. You are able to make a few adjustments of the spray. Overall, it's okay and it does do the job.

title: Easy to Use!
text: We've recently had a mouse problem in our home.  We've set up some no-kill traps and have caught a few rodents that we have then released a few miles away from the house. Although we've caught a few, we fear that there may be several more that we haven't seen yet. This spray is easy to use. It's a blend of essential oils. We've sprayed it around the exterior of the house. A day after we sprayed it, we had non-stop rain for a couple of days so we think most of it got washed away because we then found another mouse. We resprayed once it got dry again and since then we haven't seen any evidence of any mice. It hasn't been quite 2 weeks yet and from what I've read if you go 2 weeks without seeing any signs of them, you're probably mouse free. I can't say for certain, that it's the spray that is doing the job or if it's the cat that's scaring them away, but either way, I'll take it!

title: Works As Expected
text: We had a dry month recently and our lawn was suffering. We took out our old plastic sprinkler and it didn't work well any more. I ordered this and we've been very pleased. It reminded me of the sprinklers from my childhood since it's all metal. I don't know when they started making them out of plastic instead. It has a good weight to it. You can adjust the spray action. It has a far reach. Overall, it works as expected.

title: Seems to Work
text: I have been a fan of Miracle Gro for years. This is my first time I've used the formula for raised vegetable gardens. We have a small, raised bed garden. We call it our salsa garden and grow tomatoes, jalapenos, and cilantro. We followed the directions and so far this seems to work. After about 2 weeks in, our vegetables are thriving and look great!! I will definitely look for this next year.

title: Seems to Work
text: Every year we tend to have some ant issues. Usually we see them in the house after periods of heavy rains. We like using gel bait traps similar to these. These are comparable to other traps and seem to work as well. They're not messy nor is there any scent or smell noticeable to us. The ants are attracted to the bait traps and then we're assuming that they are taking the gel back to their nests. I would definitely consider reordering these again.

title: Better Than I Expected
text: We've owned a few different pop up tents over the years. They have all been in the $100 or less range. This one is listed at a higher price, and it's worth it! It's better than I expected and nicer than any of the other tents we have had. Set up is pretty much the same as the rest. It's easier with at least 2 people. The frame is sturdy (and heavy). The top/sides material is not flimsy. It's more of a fabric than vinyl. The sides work as expected. We set this up for our daughter's graduation party. We only used one of the sides on it and made the tent a selfie station. It comes with empty bags that you can fill with sand, stakes, and rope for securing the tent in questionable weather. The storage case is awesome. There are wheels in one of the pockets that you can attach to the base of the case. There are 3 sets of pockets inside the case for all of the smaller accessories. There's a separate storage bag for all of the side panels. Overall, we are very impressed with this tent. It's definitely nicer and sturdier than the cheap pop up tents. My husband was showing it off to one of his friends who commented that it was cheaper than some of the comparably priced tents, but even nicer.

title: It Really Works!!!
text: About a week ago, I found a dead mouse on the living room floor. We were so proud of our 7 year old indoor kitty. We have never had rodent problems of any kind. Then the realization came that "WE HAD A RODENT PROBLEM!" My teenage daughter is an animal lover and while she was okay with the fact that the cat was just doing what cats do, she did not want us to use any inhumane traps. I immediately ordered these mouse traps. Within just a few days of finding the dead mouse, we had 2 of these traps set up in the kitchen. The first morning after setting the traps, I found a mouse in one of them. He looked petrified, but he was alive. Later that morning, my husband took the trap to a park and released it. The traps really work! Once the mouse is caught, he cannot eat the peanut butter which we used as bait. This made my daughter unhappy. So now we have added a little bit of peanut butter to the inside of the trap so any visitors that we get can have food. It's been a few more days now and we haven't caught any more mice. I read something that says if you make it to 2 weeks without catching a mouse or seeing any evidence (mouse poop), then you're probably okay.

title: Does Reduce the Number of Mosquitoes
text: This was easy to set up and get started. The directions were well written and easy to follow. We have found that it does reduce the number of mosquitoes out on our patio, but it doesn't completely eliminate them. I'm considering getting another one so we can set one out on each side of the patio to create a barrier of some sort.

title: Feed More Birds at Once
text: This bird feeder looks great and allows you to feed more birds at once. However, the execution of the feeder is not practical when it comes to filling it with birdseed. Basically, you have to take it completely apart to fill it. The bottom section has to be unscrewed and removed from the upper level. The top has to be removed from the upper level so you can refill that. We have another brand bird feeder that is much easier to fill. For the other one, it has openings in between the connected levels that lets the bird seed flow down to the lower level without taking anything apart. The way this one works is really a 2 person job. Other than that, it's a decent plastic bird feeder. The birds do like it though. It helps when you have bully birds who won't let other birds eat with them.

title: Quiet
text: This is much smaller than I expected. The small size is actually pretty nice because it doesn't take up too much space. It's really easy to use. My sister has several of the original ones and she is a fan of them. The one she has requires a butane cartridge and this one charges with a USB cable. We found that it does an good job of keeping the mosquitoes at bay, in the immediate area where the item is located. We have a 16x20 deck. Ideally, I think 2 of these would work best for the deck area. We have seen mosquitoes just outside the area where we keep this.  This is really quiet and there's no scent associated with it. I'm not crazy about having to purchase refills. I can't find these at my local stores yet, but I'm optimistic that they will start to carry them since they sell the original refills.

title: Quiet
text: I wasn't sure what to expect from this. My sister uses the original Thermacell line and loves it, so I was very curious about this one. First of all, it is much smaller than I expected. I envisioned something the size of a gallon jug. The small size is actually pretty nice because it doesn't have a large footprint. It's really easy to use. The one my sister has requires a butane cartridge and this one charges with a USB cable. We found that it does an good job of keeping the mosquitoes at bay, in the immediate area where the item is located. Our deck is 16x20. 2 of these for the size of our deck would probably be optimal. We were keeping this on the table and we were fine as long as we were sitting there, but when we got up to go to the grill area, we would sometimes see a mosquito. This is really quiet and there's no scent associated with it. I'm not crazy about having to purchase refills. I can't find these at my local stores yet, but I'm optimistic since they have the original refills.

title: Heavy Duty!
text: It seems like every year I have to replace the garden hose nozzle. It's because I always get the cheap, plastic ones. This one is awesome! It's a heavy duty metal one that blows the others away! It is solid. There are several different spray patterns. The handle is comfortable to hold. It works great! My husband is really happy with this.

title: Heavy Duty Door Mat
text: I had a similar door mat just inside the entry way that recently lost its corner. I like using it inside as extra protection. My front porch is really just a stoop and while it is covered, it's often wet out there if there's any weather conditions. With only the outside mat, I would notice people (mainly my 17 & 21 year old kids) would still leave wet foot prints on the hardwood entry floor. This allows them to more thoroughly dry their shoes first. When I first opened it, there was a very strong odor. After a couple of days, it was gone. The patterned texture does a good job of drying off our shoes. It lays flat well. Overall, I like it.

title: Light Weight
text: Last year we bought a few of those hoses that shrink back on their own. All of them ripped or tore within a year. We loved the light weight feature, but were disappointed that they were such a short term item. This hose is nearly as light weight, but it does feel significantly sturdier. It doesn't coil back up, but that's okay. It was a bit creepy to watch the hose coil back up anyway. This is a really long hose and can reach almost the full length of our backyard. It can definitely extend to our garden so we don't have to double up on hoses. It does seem to be more difficult to get it to look nice when not using it. We haven't had any issues with it kinking up. So far, so good!

title: Comfortable!
text: This chair arrives already assembled. All you have to do is open it up. The chair is comfortable and rocks well. It's nice having a chair designed for the outdoors so I don't worry about weather damage.

title: Compact!
text: I've had several different waterproof picnic blankets over the years. This one is one of my favorites! It's thin, which makes it compact and easy to carry around. One side is the vinyl or water proof side while the other is a soft, almost flannel like side. A few of my other blankets were only plastic like and I really do like the soft side. I've also had some thicker picnic blankets, but they end up taking up more space. They're fine when you have plenty of room to store it, but this one takes up much less room. It is a little tricky to fold back up perfectly, but they all are! It took a couple of times to get it back so the handles were in the right spot, but I am sure it will get better with use. The vinyl side keeps you dry if you're sitting on damp ground. The size is pretty good, too, and the whole family can find room to sit.

title: Great for the Dorm
text: My 17 year old daughter and her friend hung this up on a wall in her bedroom. They used thumb tacks because she didn't have enough hooks with removable adhesive. It takes up almost the entire wall of her room. She didn't have any issues with the lights tangling. She didn't release the stands down until the whole thing was hanging up. She will be going to college next year and wants to hang it up in her dorm. So when she takes it down, she will be sure to be careful and wrap up each individual strand to prevent a big mess. This powers up with a USB end, so you do need a power brick or something like that to power it up. On the USB end, there's a button which allows you to scroll through the different settings. It has several different speeds/patterns to choose from. She absolutely loves it and says it is one of her favorite room accessories.

title: Decent Pop Up Tent
text: My first reaction when I opened this tent, was that the material was thin. I was expecting thicker, vinyl type material. However, my husband said that this was just like what the marching band buys at the sporting goods store. So basically, this is the equivalent to the cheaper ones available in the stores. There was no pricing available on the product description as I was writing this, so I will just assume that it falls in that similar price range. I was pleased to see that there are several points where there is velcro so it can be securely attached to the frame. The frame was easy enough for my husband and I to put together. The 10x10 size is a good size for our needs. You can easily fit a couple of tables and some chairs underneath it. It's light weight and fits nicely in the case that comes with it.

title: Great Quality
text: This Amazon Basics patio heater is pretty impressive. It's nicer than some of the ones that I have seen at the local hardware chain store. It took a while before my husband had the time available to put it together. He's very handy and has assembled all kinds of things. This item took a couple of hours to put together from start to finish. I didn't pay attention to the time when he started, but it was at least a good 2 hours. It comes with a sealed package with all of the screws, bolts, nuts, etc that are needed for assembly. I really like how that is done rather than little baggies. It even includes a simple screw driver and a wrench in case you didn't have one. My husband actually used his own power tools for most of the job. He said that if he had to use only the tools provided, it would have been a much slower process. He also said that it would not be the ideal project for someone who is not experienced with putting together equipment or similar items. The directions were extremely small in both size of paper and size of print. My husband said that was something he noticed on another Amazon Basic brand item that he built a few months ago. The instruction booklet is about the size of a smart phone. It really should be larger! It was difficult to read at times. The heater is really tall. My husband is 6'2" and it was several inches taller than him. Because it was a chilly day, he put it together in the kitchen. He had to tilt it and roll it out the patio door. It does have a pair of wheels on one side which makes it easier to move. I wish there was some kind of handle or something to hold on to when pushing it though. It produces heat well and has been a great addition to our patio with the cooler fall weather.

title: Keeps My Loveseat Dry
text: I am loving this loveseat cover. I got some beautiful patio furniture recently, but it came with cream colored cushions. The cushions are weather proof, but the first time they were left out in the rain, they become over saturated with water and couldn't be used for a while. Plus, they started to stain from wet leaves touching them. I took all of the cushion covers off and washed them, but have been storing them inside unless I was going to use them. Talk about a pain! It got to the point, where most of the time I was too lazy to bring them outside. Well, now I can leave them on the furniture and it does a great job of protecting my cushions. This fits my loveseat perfectly.  We've had quite a bit of rain recently and when I've checked them, they are completely dry. I am very pleased with this. I need to order a matching one for the sofa.

title: Easy to Fill
text: As just a bird feeder, I am very pleased with this. It has a large capacity. It's easy to fill and it looks beautiful. It's been very popular with the local birds. The light feature is a nice thought, but it's kind of pointless if you're using it as a bird feeder because the bird food blocks it. I know it works, because we tried it before we filled it up. But even now, with it being half full of food, we're still not seeing any light. We have several bird feeders hanging in our back yard and at night, I can't tell the difference between this one and any of the others. Personally, that's fine with me, the light feature was not the selling point for me. Overall, it's been an excellent bird feeder so far, however the lantern feature is a little weak.

title: Keeps My Chair & Cushions Dry!
text: I got some nice patio furniture over the summer. At first I was leaving the cushions on them all the time, but then we had lots of rain and the cushions were soaked. The cream colored cushions of my outdoor sofa got stains all over them from wet leaves. So I started taking the cushions off of everything and leaving them in the basement until we needed them. Then that became quite the pain. I found that I wasn't spending as much time outside because I didn't want to put all the cushions back. Then I got some Duck Covers. This cover easily fits my wicker Adirondack style chair. We don't live near any coasts, but we're getting lots of rain right now because of some of the hurricanes. I went to check on my furniture. There were puddles of water on the cover where the seat is, so I was sure it had soaked through to the cushion, but when I lifted the cover off, I was pleasantly surprised to find that the cushion was completely dry. I even sat down on it to be sure. The cover is heavy and sturdy. There are some straps for a tight fit and keep it in place. The cover itself has a nice neutral look . I am so pleased with it! It's so much easier to use my furniture now!

title: Protects My Grill
text: We just bought a new grill this summer, but we were still using our old grill cover. It was so sad looking! It had some tears and really needed to go in the trash. Our grill is a 4 burner one and has a burner on one side and the other side has a work space. This grill cover fits it perfectly without being tight. I like the little pocket on the front, though we're not using it yet. It does look like it will hold our grill tools, but then when we remove the cover, we will have to take them out before hand so it will be easier to remove. I personally am not familiar with the brand and I could definitely do without having the logo plastered largely on the front. I'm also not a fan of the camouflage trim on the bottom, but other than that, it's a great cover and does the job.

title: Beautiful Chairs!
text: These chairs do require some assembly. The arms and the back have to be attached to the base. It does come with an allen key, but my husband found it was easier to use his drill since he had the right bit for it. Attaching the back piece was easy, though he did need me to help by holding it in place. The arms were a little more challenging and required him to apply enough pressure to align the holes. One of the screws was chipped and he had to find a replacement in his tool box. Once it was put together, the chairs are sturdy and beautiful. I personally could do without the bolster pillow. I would prefer either a full pillow or no pillow. The bolster pillow doesn't allow you to lean against the back very easily.

title: Difficult to Hang Up
text: This bird feeder is huge! It's much larger than I expected. It is pretty much a two person job to fill and hang this up. We didn't have enough birdseed to fill it up, which ended up being a good thing. If you fill it all the way up, it is pretty heavy. I was holding the bird feeder while my husband was attaching the lid. We kept losing the washers that go on top. The handle part was difficult to put into the holes of the bar that goes through the tube. It was really pretty comical. We wish it would have come with an "S" hook or something similar. We ended up using one . It was near impossible to get it hung up without it. One of the product pictures showed it hanging with an "S" hook. We finally did get it hanging up, but not before spilling half of the birdseed onto the yard. I think it would be better if the top pieces were attached more permanently. Ones that you could tilt/lift up, but they don't come off all the way. Anyway.....once it was up, it's doing a good job. I haven't gotten to see any squirrels get kicked off it yet, but I haven't seen them eating from it either. Overall, it's a okay.

title: Top of the Line!
text: This flat top griddle cover is top of the line. I am very impressed with it. I ordered it for a bar height table w/ built in fire pit, but it wasn't large enough for that. However, it does fit my grill, so I am pleased.  I was more than happy to throw away the grill cover that was covering our grill. It was torn so badly, that I really wonder how well it was protecting our grill! This cover is heavy duty. I love the drawstring and buckle straps. There was nothing like that on the old cover. My husband used to have to tie it down with bungee cords when heavy winds were expected. There are handles on the sides, though I'm not sure if they'll get used much, but they are attached securely to the cover. I plan to check out some of the other specialty covers they have for some of our other patio furniture.

title: Missing One of the Perches
text: My bird feeder came with only one perch/slotted cover. The other side was just a hole. I thought it was a strange bird feeder because all of the worms would fall out the hole on the other side. I looked up the picture on the description and saw that there should be a perch/slotted cover on both sides, so mine was missing one. We put some duct tape over the cover (sticky side facing away from the opening and then another piece attaching it to the plastic because we didn't want worms sticking to the tape). That at least allowed us to keep the worms inside the tube. When adding the dried worms, some did fall out of the slots.  It's been a few days and it doesn't look like many worms have been eaten yet, but it's there in case any feathered friend is interested.

title: Easy to Assemble!
text: This outdoor side table was very easy to put together. It is made from a sturdy resin and perfect for outdoor use. Although there's storage space inside, it's fairly solid and can easily withstand the weight of heavier objects, not just your cups and plates. It has a faux wood grain look. The storage is a nice feature. It doesn't take up a lot of room on our deck and is great for entertaining.

title: Works Much Better Than I Expected
