text: When this arrived, I really wasn't sure if it was going to work or not. The planter was easy to assemble, but I was still skeptical that it was going to do anything. It doesn't take up a lot of space, but so far, it's doing a good job. We've got little sprouts of cilantro growing in our kitchen. It's made from a plastic coated cardboard and I was expecting it to leak or something, so I have been pleasantly surprised with it. I'm terrible about remembering to water plants, so this is perfect for me. I usually don't think of it until it starts drooping or turning brown. I'm thinking about ordering another one so I can grow peppermint.

title: It Really Works!
text: I am very impressed with the Ortho Fire Ant Killer Mound Bait. The first time we sprinkled some of this out in the yard, we had some unexpected rain. We weren't sure if the rain washed it away or not, so we waited a few days to see what was going on. The ants were still there, so we tried again. This time, we had no rain. We went back to check on it a few days after applying it to the mound. No more ants! Other than the rain interfering, it was easy to use and did what it was supposed to do. I would definitely recommend this ant killer.

title: So Much Better Than the Old Blue Tarp!
text: This is a huge improvement over the old blue tarp we've been using for yard clean up! It is a little bit thicker than what we were using. But my favorite thing is the handles! The old blue tarp didn't have any handles, so you had to grab them by the corners. The handles on this are comfortable and easy to grip. Plus, you can secure them together to create a large bundle. This is sturdy and well made.  It can carry a pretty heavy load, too. This is going to be a game changer this fall when it's time to rake the leaves!

title: Slow Results
text: I live in Georgia and have Bermuda grass. So far, this seems to be working. We've had a very rainy summer, but I did find the chance to apply it in a test area by the patio. It took longer than I expected to see any results. I thought maybe the rain had interfered with its performance. But when I just checked on it, the weeds were brown and dead. The Bermuda grass was unharmed.  There was about ten days between application and results. The product description said it was fast acting and kills weeds on contact. Ten days is not very fast acting in my opinion. I do like that I have an option for getting rid of some of that crab grass that is growing in my yard. I found the applicator was easy to use.

title: Great for Small Jobs Around the House
text: We've never owned a pressure washer before, but we have rented or borrowed  both gas powered and electric pressure washers over the years. My husband is pleased to have his own now. It was quick and easy to assemble. It didn't take long at all before it was ready to use. This one did a surprisingly nice job. You can adjust the pressure/stream for your needs. We tried it out on our patio. We have a hot tub out there and the concrete around it was getting a bit green. This did a great job of cleaning the concrete area around the hot tub.My husband said he probably wouldn't want to use this to clean the whole driveway. He says he would probably still rent or borrow a larger, gas powered model.  It's not as noisy as a gas powered one, which is a good thing. The hose reel is a nice feature, but the handle has to be removed in order to wind up the hose. The wheels move adequately for movement, but it's not a smooth ride. Overall, it's great for smaller, home jobs.

title: Helps Cool You Down in the Heat
text: This misting fan is a decent quality. I've seen a few misting fans that are higher quality, but this is definitely better than dollar store or discount store quality. The base of the fan has a cute Finding Nemo wrap/design. The rest of the fan is in coordinating orange and turquoise. It does not come with a battery, so you do need to provide your own double A battery for it to operate. The fan blades are a soft foam material so they won't hurt little (or big) fingers. It sprays a fine mist when you press the trigger button. There is a slide button on the top to control the on and off of the fan. The fan provides a modest amount of air. When combined with the water mist, it does offer a cooling relief from the heat. This would appeal to young kids and adults during the hot summer months.

title: Easy to Use & Convenient
text: My husband replaced his smaller, corded Black & Decker trimmer with this one. There was no assembly required which is always a plus. It's significantly longer/larger than his Black & Decker one, so he gets a farther reach with this one. That allows him to trim the back sides of bushes easier. It didn't take too long for it to fully charge. You do have to remove the battery when not in use. The battery is 40 volt which offers a lot of power. Because it's cordless, it's more portable and convenient than his older one. He loves that he doesn't have to mess with the extension cord when using it. It's not as loud as a gas powered trimmer. Plus with gas powered ones, you have to mix oil and gasoline to power it. He is really appreciating how simple this one is.

title: Works as Expected
text: We drain our hot tub every couple of months. And when we do, we need to reestablish the bromine levels. We've used this brand before and it works as expected. We use bromide tablets to maintain the levels in between drainings. This is definitely more affordable than going to the pool/spa store.

title: Easy to Set Up!
text:
We've purchased a few different hoses this summer for our different needs. The hoses used to share one connector, but it was kind of pain to switch hoses. Now we don't have to! In fact, it so easy to use the hoses now, I find that I am more willing to go water the sapling or the garden because of it. You can shut the water off any unused valves which is handy if you don't have four hoses connected to it. This splitter is solid and heavy duty. It comes with plenty of washers, too. This was easy to install right out of the box.

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Good price!
text: This past fourth of July, we decided to grill kabobs. I went to three stores and they were all out of bamboo skewers! It must have been on everyone's holiday menu. I was able to find a few in my kitchen drawer and we were able to make it work, but the next day I saw these online and decided to be proactive and order them. The price is great. The stores had them priced much higher for fewer skewers. These are exactly what I was looking for. We usually soak them in water first, then load them with veggies or meat.

title: Nice Assortment of Garden Tools
text: I've been frustrated with my husband regarding my garden tools. They keep disappearing. I think it's more of an organization thing, or should I say lack of organization. I thought it might improve if I had a garden tote to keep all of my gardening supplies together. The bag is a little smaller than I expected. It's kind of flimsy. The handles are not reinforced or padded. There are several outer pockets which can accommodate a lot of tools. The tools that were included are a decent quality. Though one of the items had a chipped/flawed handle. When it's loaded with everything that it came with, there was still room for me to add a few of the items that I already had. This will do the job and for the price, it's fine.

title: Light Weight Yet Heavy Duty!
text:
I really wasn't sure that I was going to like this. I've seen similar hoses advertised and I just didn't get it. Now that I have one, I am sold! These hoses are great! It's light weight and is easy to carry. Traditional hoses are pretty heavy. When water is flowing, the hose changes into a more traditional hose, but it reverts back to itself after the water is turned off. The ends of this hose have heavy, brass fittings. Those are so much nicer than what I have on my old hoses. You can shut off the hose at the end with a lever. This set comes with a Y-splitter which has proven to be very handy. I can leave one hose leading to the vegetable garden and have another hose by the patio. The spray nozzle is a nice bonus, too. I am so happy with this!

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Caught Some Fruit Flies
text:
I ordered these for some outdoor entertaining I plan to do this summer. They are small and unobtrusive. One end is pointed so it can be placed down into the dirt, the other side is flower shaped. The flower part is super sticky, which is necessary to catch those pesky bugs. The smell is a mild, natural-type smell. I'm not sure if the smell is intended or not. We have a lot of lizards in our backyard, so I love that these are non-toxic and won't harm them. I couldn't find any indication as to how long it should last. Obviously, when it's covered in bugs and there's limited space for new occupants, but I don't know how often I should replace them. I did notice some fruit flies in the kitchen recently and I was able to use one of these. The weather wasn't too hot, so I had one propped up in the window sill of the kitchen window. We found a few fruit flies on it, but it did not get rid of all of them. It may have been a poor choice of location though.

*I received this for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Helps Organize Your Garden!
text:
My family recently planted our garden, so these garden plant markers arrived just in time. We don't plant a huge variety, but it is nice to see our vegetables marked. My teen daughter wanted the task of labeling our plants. She used a permanent marker to label them. These markers are a sturdy plastic material. They provide enough room to write on. There's a big variety of colors which my daughter enjoyed using to color coordinate our veggies. They are reuseable, but with 100 markers, it will be a long time before we run out.

*I received these for free in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Nice Size
text:
We have plans for a lot of outdoor entertaining this summer, so I have been looking for some kind of shade covering to use. The material seems durable. I've never seen anything like it before. It's kind of porous looking. The edges are nice looking. I actually like that it doesn't keep the rain out because it won't pool on top and risk harming it. If it's raining, we'll go inside. We want something that provides shade and potentially cooler temperatures. Traditional tarps don't allow the flow of air through either, but this one will. We haven't figured out where we are going to put it yet. It's large enough to cover more than half of our deck, but we are leaning to have it out in the yard. It comes with hooks and ropes, but my husband is looking into getting some poles since we can't find a space where there are trees or the deck posts on all sides.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Sturdy
text:
Many years ago, we had a couple of benches similar to this one. They’re great for additional seating outside. This was pretty easy to set up. It took my husband and me less than half an hour. The directions were easy to follow. All of the hardware was included. The most time consuming part was getting rid of the Styrofoam that crumbled from the box. It was everywhere! There were some flaws in the wood pieces. A few of the boards were pretty scratched up a bit. However, this is going to be outside and exposed to the elements and will weather over time anyway. So in the long run, that doesn't really bother me too much. The bench is sturdy and looks great out on our deck. We plan to move it down into the yard when we decided where to the best place to put it.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Beautiful Addition to Our Patio
text:
[[VIDEOID:7c2183688f2960f99192db35f54b288b]] I am loving this 3 jar fountain! We've been slowly trying to transform our lower level patio into a beautiful extended living space and this is helping us get there. This fountain brings so much character to our little area. It's made of a lightweight resin material and is very easy to pick up and move around. It was simple to set up and get started. It looks like a rustic pottery fountain straight from Italy. The tallest jar comes up just past my knees. When on a level surface, the water stays completely in the fountain. If it's not level, a little water sometimes misses the sweet spot and runs down onto the surrounding ground. It has a nice, soothing sound that adds to the ambiance. I just need some better furniture out there and I won't want to leave!

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Helping to De-Stress My Teen Daughter!
text:
My 14 year old daughter has been under a lot of stress this semester. She's taking her first AP class and she's been participating in her school Winter Guard program. She's already decided that's too much and that she won't do Winter Guard next year, but she is finishing this season. I purchased this Zen Garden in hopes that it would help calm and relax her. It has been a big hit! She loves it. She has been rearranging her Zen garden almost daily. She keeps it on her desk and will take study breaks to rake her sand or rearrange her stones. The whole set is a nice size. It's smaller than a standard sheet of notebook paper. The sand has some sparkles to it which she likes. As far as the quality of the set, it's pretty basic. It isn't a super high quality one, but it's not falling apart either.

*I purchased this at a discounted price in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Love the Telescoping Feature!
text:
This is our 3rd set of campfire sticks and by far our favorite! The telescoping feature is really handy. Usually the forks are cumbersome and bulky, but these hardly take any room. I've included a couple of pictures to show the difference in size when it's fully extended. These are actually longer than our other two sets which is preferred. So many times we end up being too close to the fire. These allow you to keep a nice, safe distance. The ends are sharp enough to spear marshmallows & other roasting items. They come with little red, plastic tip covers, but I wouldn't be surprised if they ended up getting misplaced after a while. The handle does a pretty good job of keeping your hands from getting too hot. It's also comfortable to hold on to. It comes with a storage bag to keep them together. I do wish the bag was just a little wider. Because of their size, they are very portable and can easily be put in a backpack or other camping gear.

*I received these for free for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Strong & Sturdy!
text:
When these first arrived, I gave them to my husband and instructed him to try it out. There were no instructions included with the package, so he looped them around a couple of trees & hung his hammock up. Then when he tested it, the straps stretched quite a bit to the point that the hammock touched the ground. He then proceeded to tell me that they didn't work. So I went to read the other reviews. There were several that mentioned a similar experience, but there were many that said it worked as it should. Then I checked out the actual product description. In the last picture of the product, there were instructions. There I learned that you need to wrap it multiple times and layer the straps a bit. We tried that & I am happy to say that it worked beautifully! I am a plus-sized woman and the hammock & straps held me in securely without slipping. We did not use the clips that were provided because I had left them in the house, plus our hammock has nice metal clips already. These will work nicely when you have larger trees and your hammock straps/rope won't fit around the tree. In the end, we are very happy with them. It would be very nice if written instructions were included though.

*I received these for the purpose of trying out & reviewing. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: As Expected!
text: Great bromine tablets! They are as expected. Minimal breakage of tablets - no more than other packages.

title: Heavy Duty Grill Gloves!
text: I have not used regular hot pads/oven mitts in years. A while back I discovered the "Ove Glove" as seen on TV. These are similar to them, but much better. They can withstand a much hotter temperature than any other grilling/cooking gloves that I have seen. I like the darker colors. I have 2 pairs of other brand cooking gloves and the base for both of them is white/off white. I am constantly getting them dirty! BBQ sauce and other food items won't show up as easily on this pair. They are quite large. I have big hands & these make me feel dainty! But even though they are large, they aren't too loose which might be a safety concern. I also like to use them as hot pads. I have gotten rid of all my old style hot pads & oven mitts. I purchased these during a promotional period so I could test these out and I am very please with them! I am looking forward to the arrival of warmer weather so we can start using this with the grill.

title: Light weight, but Sturdy!
text: It is light weight, but very sturdy. The netting is very strong. It does a great job of skimming debris out of our hot tub. I love that it attaches to a broom handle if you don't have a pole!

title: These make that tedious job of shredding, so much easier and faster!
text: My husband made fun of me for ordering these, but he's not the one who ends up shredding or pulling the meat. These make that tedious job of shredding, so much easier and faster! First of all, they were sharper than I was expecting. They are light weight & easy to grip. It was practically effortless to pull apart the pork shoulder I had cooked. I have a couple of recipes that I don't use very often because they call for shredded chicken and I don't like to go to the trouble because shredding with forks is such a nuisance. But now, I am excited to make them because the claws make shredding so easy!

title: Amazing Grill Set!
text: I originally got this with the idea of using it as a gift, but once it arrived & I saw it in person, I'm not so sure. I may be keeping them for myself! These are nice, solid, stainless tools. So much higher quality than the ones we currently have with the wooden handles. They are a bit large, but I'm not the primary griller, so they should work well for my husband. I really like the serrated edge on the spatula for cutting into the meat to check the pinkness level. I'm sure my husband will really like the bottle opener feature.

title: Very Easy to Use.
text: We are fairly new hot tub owners. At first, all the chemicals and maintenance were a bit overwhelming to me. These test strips are super helpful. They are easy to use. Just dip them in the hot tub & wait for 15 seconds. Then compare the colors on the strip to the chart on the back of the bottle. We try to test the water at least once a week. Then add the proper chemicals as necessary.

title: Weed/herb seed.
text:
I mixed this in with some grass seed, without planting a tester batch, and threw this seed out on some dirt that was newly cleared from foxtail and stickers in my backyard.. I wish I hadn't... I am sad to report that probably closer to 99% (package says total of 1%) of what is coming in is weeds. Unfortunately one of the four or five different weeds/herbs is stinging nettle and I am once again fighting a weed that may cause injury/irritation to my dogs. I am trying to save the clover that is coming in, by hand weeding out nettle, but it is gonna be a battle that might be better won by clearing the whole spot and starting over again.

Update 10/26/19: In all my careful observation, I have only seen 3 actual clovers. Very disappointed. Water coming off. Letting it all die so we can clear and start again. Keeping the weed seed for the deep yard, it is ground cover, just not clover.

Planting a tester pot of these seeds to show proof it is the seed from the bag and not others from my yard. Will report back again when the tester pot germanates.

text:
[[VIDEOID:f2cdc2eaebc47d1c45bdafa508c21f8a]] These are fabulous for keeping my flowerbeds watered during the hot summers here. I wish I had known about these before as my traditional sprinkler failed to stop my flowerbeds from dehydrating. I am planning on getting a timer on the faucet but for now I manually turn the water on and off. Depending on how dry the soil is you can either turn the water on low or high and either way these flower sprinklers work amazingly which I have to be honest I was surprised about. I was not expecting them to cope with full water pressure but I was wrong! I buried the hose under the mulch so all that is showing is the flower sprinkler. The heads are adjustable so you can have 360 degree spray or for me I changed it so it sprays sideways and covers my flower bed. Each individual flower can also be turned off if you don't want all of them watering at once.

It's a great item and really happy with it. Will be ordering more so I can use in my other two separate flower beds around the other side of the house.

title: Great Affordable and Green Friendly Grow Light
text:
The GreenGo 1200W LED grow light is great for small grows and the price is great when comparing to other blurple LED grow lights. I am using it in a 4x4 and it was perfect for veg. I bought it to replace my Sunraise 1000W which just wasn't cutting it in that size of space. The 1200W GreenGo came with a power cable and all the necessary tools to hang it, including wire hangers and a racheted pully to adjust the height as your plants grow.

The light also has its own fans/cooling system. It never gets hot and doesn't require a separate cooling exhaust like my 1000W HPS hood. That ends up saving you even more on your electric bill.

The girls didn't stretch much and grew great under the light. It was perfect thoughout the veg stage. Once they started to flower, I switched the Bloom lights on and also left the veg lights on. The girls really seemed to enjoy it. They are in their final weeks of flowering now and are still very happy ladies. I recently added my 1000W Sunraise back to the tent because my plants were getting large and it was getting hard to make sure all plants had direct light coverage. This was easy to do because the light supports daisy chaining. I was able to plug my old light directly into the GreenGo LED light and get it going immediately. Very nice option.

All in all this is a great, affordable, simple to use light that requires no extra cooling and I will continue to use it in the future. Do not hesitate to purchase.

Within a few hours after setting the traps out, I noticed that the ants were moving slower and by the next day I saw a significantly reduced amount of ants. Within a couple of days, the ants had completely disappeared and they stayed away.

I have allergies and I have to be very careful about using any type of chemical products in my house. Although I have had an allergic reaction to some ant bait chemicals in the past, I have never experienced an allergic reaction to the TERRO brand.

I highly recommend this brand. It does a great job of eliminating the ants and it doesn't have any offensive odor.

title: Calcium Carbonate an alternative to OTC antacid tablets
text:
This is a good alternative to standard OTC antacid tablets that contain flavorings and other "inactive" ingredients like adipic acid (adding an acid to an antacid makes no sense to me). This product is simply Calcium Carbonate, the active ingredient in antacid tablets and the only one you need. I stir about 1/2 teaspoon of this powder in 4 oz of water. The result is a milky color and consistency with almost no taste (except for a slight chalkboard chalk taste). Works faster and provides better relief for me than any of the chalky, gritty antacid tablets I've used in the past.
UPDATE: For those using Calcium Carbonate as a calcium supplement or antacid, I now prefer the Now Foods 12oz product which has no chalkboard taste and has a slightly finer texture that dissolves easier in water.

title: Battery Charger Could Be Better
text: I was looking for an all-in-one solar panel and Ni-MH battery charger I could use to recharge my Enveloop AA/AAA batteries.  This product marginally works, but the weakness is the Guide 10 Plus charger.  You can only charge 4 batteries at a time, and the batteries are not charged independently.  If you need to charge 2 partially depleted batteries and put 2 fully charged batteries in the remaining slots, I find that when the charge cycle completes, those depleted batteries have lower end-of-charge voltage than the others e.g. 1.18V-1.25V compared to 1.30-1.45V for the others.  A separate wall-powered charger capable of independently charging of each battery is really needed to supplement this product to get the most out of your  batteries by putting a full balanced charge into the batteries, at least periodically.  One minor annoyance is the batteries are installed with the negative terminals at the top, which seems opposite of the more common convention of positive terminals up.

title: Good but tricky to get working
text:
Once you get this going it's pretty good:

PROS: Indoor and outdoor temp and humidity; big clear display that lights up; small solar panel on indoor unit extends the battery life; weather forecasting function is surprisingly accurate; clock sets itself.

CONS: It can be a pain to get the outdoor unit working with the indoor unit; every time it needs a new battery you have to reset everything all over again; radio range of the outdoor until is nowhere near the 100 feet it states in the manual -- I had to put the outdoor unit directly outside my window and the indoor unit near the window for it to work; clock only sets itself once a day; inconsistent temp and humidity (put the indoor and outdoor unit directly next to each other and they each give a difference temp and humidity level).

So, when it works it's nice and useful. But it can be frustrating sometimes getting the radio signal to work properly between the two units.

title: Appearance yes; bird-friendly, errr...maybe
text:
This is a fine-looking and well made feeder. However birds are firced to sit IN the tray to consume the seed. There is really nothing for them to hold onto. The tray edge itself is is a bit too thick all around.

Squirrels LOVE the openness and are easily able to hang on and enjoy. For this reason I cannot hang this feeder on a pole.

These were misgivings I had when I ordered it, soooooo no one to blame but...me.

title: A good choice among electric snow blowers!
text:
I ordered this blower when my gas powered unit would not cooperate with me and start after a foot of snow. By the time my SNOW JOE arrived, the snow had turned to ice. I have not and will not ever try to snow blow ice. So, I haven't used it yet. But I can say this:
1. Assembly involves attaching the chute and its control arm, locking the upper part of the handle in place, attaching the upper and middle portions of the handle to the lower portion of the blower (what the knobs and J-joints are for), and then looking at your handiwork. The wheels were already attached out of the box.

2. The engine purrs like a small but powerful whisper jet. I wear hearing aids, but the sound did not jar me.

3. The unit weighs 37 lbs. Easy enough to maneuver but also likely to balk on ice or slush. I can live with that because I expect to use this on powdery snowfall as much as possible. My expectations are reasonable from a 37 pounder.

4. I believe the unit is well made and more than reasonably priced.

The directions show you that the cotter pin for use with the chute control rod is in the hole at the end of the rod. Mine was in a hole that is part of the chute. No matter, because you have to remove it to use it properly. I did wonder where it was at first.

I spoke to a CSR after assembly and told him what I will tell you: I believe this SNOW JOE will work just fine.

UPDATE AFTER FIRST USE ON A FOOT OF SNOW:
Without question if you want an electric snow blower, this is the one to buy.
It cleared a foot of snow on the first pass - I found no need to go back over the same area. Took the snow right down to the cement. Job well done! I used a 50-ft. 15amp cord, highly recommended.

I am 80 yrs. on this planet, I was able to push this baby over rough spots with little effort. If I can do it, YOU can do it! Tilting the blower is sometimes very helpful.

Now I am used to a gas-powered workhorse snow blower that put the snow a good distance away. This blower has a smaller chute and while it does get the snow out of your way, you will find that wind will put some of the snow...right back atcha! Wear suitable clothing and avoid blowing the snow into the wind. Keep the wind at your back and you will be fine.

It took me about as long to remove the snow with this blower as it did with my Sherman-tank gas powered one. I don't think I can ask for more. 5 stars and more!

title: 4 Stars, with reservations
text:
This is my 2nd Champion gen, purchased because I can use propane (cancer patient) and my first one took a lot of weather abuse over 8 years but still has a solid working engine.

I have used it only to run it a few times to be sure it would start. It has done so.
I am generally satisfied and I do recommend this product. Note that I ran it on my 15lb propane tank flawlessly. The standard tank in my neck of the woods is a 15lb-er.

I am able to move the unit around fairly easily and I am not as strong as I once was.

I am disappointed in the entire choke mechanism. The lever is vibrating plastic and seems very flimsy. I have no idea what 75% choke means or which setting that is. I have found the choke mechanism makes starting a pain. I started and stopped the gen a few times, trying to develop a sure-fire starting pattern. I have yet to find it.

I am happy for a unit that uses propane and solves a health concern for me by eliminating the gasoline problem.

If the only glitch long-term is the choke, I will be more than grateful.

title: Of two sprayers, only ONE works  NOW SEE UPDATE!
text:

UPDATE: The seller REPLACED the unusable sprayer with a FRESH 2-PACK! Both of the replacements work very well. You cannot beat that level of quality service. These spray bottles are important because we have a horde of spotted lantern flies which can be conquered only by spraying with equal parts water and dish detergent. title: Easily Moves Leaves and More!
text:
This is my 3rd Greenworks tool, and I am willing to say it will equal the quality I have come to expect from GW.
This unit is powerful - it has SIX speeds set by a rolling knob. Plenty enough wind to move all kinds of leaves and dirt and spilled potting soil even!
It is very light to handle. If this old man can handle it, you can too!
It seems to use up more battery reserve than my GW mower, but that is what the charger is for. I have two GW batteries, so not a problem for me.
I think you will be happy with this money-well-spent blower!

title: Easy to maneuver, not too heavy
text:

title: Reluctant to keep using these mats
text:
After reading the Amazon reviews, they sounded good enough to try, but we are disappointed. We have used one of the two mats, we find that food does stick, and we must soak and wash and soak and wash it to remove whatever has stuck. Frankly we are not sure if what we are removing is food or the mat itself. I do not see any threadbare areas, so I assume we have not been consuming the mat material -- I wish I could be sure.

I figured if they didn't work we would not have blown too much price-wise. More than likely we will not use them again.

title: Very well made and does the job!
text: My wife is the primary user of this pruner. She has used it so much that the front, side, and back of the house are looking pretty good! Her hands are small to medium and she is not strong of hand, so I must "unlatch" it when she wants to use it and when she is finished. That latch is very hard to move. Of course, you need to lock the pruner or it will wind up pruning more than the greenery. It most certainly does the job once you get it open!

title: You really do need one of these if you use your grill a lot! UPDATED May 2015
text:
If you have looked for this type of product, you know they are not all that easy to find. I was delighted when I found Amazon offering this one.I have used it for a few weeks now, and I am confident that it does the job.

Here is what you need to know:
1. the gauge needs to sit as low as possible on your tank. My tank sits in a holder, so I can only get it so low on the tank. However, this did not seem to affect accuracy (based on one tank that ran out of propane). The device attaches with magnets and is easily removed and reattached.

2. When the tank is near-empty, the device emits a tone similar to a video game. The tone is continuous once it starts chirping until you shut off the tank valve. I found that I had about three 1/2-hour uses left once the alert started.

3. It requires two AA batteries.

So far, so good!

UPDATE May 2015: It has been two years since I started using this gauge. The original batteries still have life in them. The item continues to work as well as it did fresh out of the box. This is a fine, fine gauge and well worth your consideration. I have found it to be 100% accurate.
